jobs.description:
As a member of the Compliance team, you will play a key role in delivering the Compliance mandate to Zurich’s Group Functions, with a particular focus on Dealing in Securities well as Anti-Trust and Fair Competition. In support of Zurich’s strategic priorities, you will enable business and functional stakeholders to pursue their objectives in a compliant manner by providing pragmatic advice, helping to embed a strong compliance culture and independently assessing, monitoring and challenging compliance risks.

The role holder is responsible for contributing to the development, implementation and continuous enhancement of the compliance framework across the relevant businesses and functions, with a primary focus on Dealing in Securities, including relevant SIX requirements, as well as Anti-Trust and Fair Competition. This includes helping to establish fit-for-purpose guidance, supporting consistent implementation and working closely with a broad range of stakeholders within and outside Group Compliance at group, regional and local level.

As a trusted advisor, you will combine subject-matter expertise with sound judgment, curiosity, adaptability and a collaborative mindset, translating regulatory and ethical requirements into practical, business-relevant solutions.

What you will do

As a Senior Compliance Expert – Dealing in Securities , Anti-Trust and Fair Competition, your main responsibilities will include:

- Supporting the maintenance and continuous enhancement of a robust and effective compliance framework, with a primary focus on Dealing in Securities, relevant SIX requirements, Anti-Trust and Fair Competition

- Providing expert compliance advice, input and guidance on personal account dealing, information barriers, market conduct, relevant SIX requirements, anti-trust and fair competition topics to business stakeholders and the Compliance network across group, regional and local level

- Developing and enhancing guidance, reporting, assessment approaches, training and awareness materials, and supporting their effective implementation across the organization in a pragmatic, engaging and business-relevant way

- Supporting the interpretation and application of internal requirements and external regulatory expectations relating to employee securities transactions, conflicts of interest, watch and restricted list controls, and competition law risks

- Collaborating closely with other assurance and control functions, including Legal, Risk and Audit, to support coherent and effective management of relevant compliance risks

- Acting as a trusted partner to local and regional Compliance officers and supporting consistent interpretation and application of requirements across jurisdictions and business contexts

- Engaging with senior stakeholders across Group Functions, understanding business models, products, processes and transformation initiatives, and contributing to compliant and sustainable outcomes

- Contributing to oversight, monitoring and assurance activities in the relevant areas of expertise, including the identification, assessment and escalation of material issues where appropriate

- Participating in and supporting strategic projects, regulatory change initiatives and cross-functional programmes relevant to the role’s area of expertise, with agility in responding to evolving business, regulatory and technology developments

What you bring

As a Senior Compliance Expert – Dealing in Securities , Anti-Trust and Fair Competition, your skills and qualifications will ideally include:

- At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in Dealing in Securities, securities compliance, market conduct, Anti-Trust, Fair Competition or broader compliance or legal roles, ideally within a complex and international environment

- Strong knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, industry standards and emerging developments, in particular in relation to employee securities transactions, market conduct, relevant SIX requirements, Anti-Trust and Fair Competition

- University degree in law,; an advanced degree or additional relevant qualifications would be an advantage

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex matters, exercise sound judgment, demonstrate learning agility and intellectual curiosity, and translate requirements into practical guidance

- Ability to provide clear management information and deliver concise, high-quality reporting for different stakeholder groups

- Strong interpersonal, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, including credibility and confidence in working with senior management and cross-functional teams, and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, cultures and levels of seniority

- Ability to prioritize effectively, navigate complexity, work independently and deliver to a high standard in a dynamic international environment

- Strong written and verbal communication, presentation and facilitation skills

- Good command of standard productivity and collaboration tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint and Microsoft 365

- Fluent written and spoken English is essential with addition language being an advantage

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.

For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.

Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di membro del team Compliance, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel fornire il mandato di Compliance alle Funzioni del Gruppo di Zurigo, con un particolare focus sul Dealing in Securities così come Anti-Trust e Fair Competition. A sostegno delle priorità strategiche di Zurigo, si permetterà agli stakeholder aziendali e funzionali di perseguire i propri obiettivi in modo conforme fornendo consigli pragmatici, aiutando a incorporare una forte cultura di conformità e valutando in modo indipendente, monitorando e sfidando i rischi di conformità.

Il titolare del ruolo è responsabile di contribuire allo sviluppo, all'implementazione e al miglioramento continuo del quadro di conformità tra le aziende e le funzioni pertinenti, con un focus primario su Dealing in Securities, compresi i requisiti SIX rilevanti, così come Anti-Trust e Fair Competition. Ciò include l'aiuto alla creazione di una guida fit-for-purpose, il supporto all'implementazione coerente e il lavoro a stretto contatto con una vasta gamma di stakeholder all'interno e all'esterno della Compliance di Gruppo a livello di gruppo, regionale e locale.

In qualità di consulente di fiducia, unirete le competenze di soggetto-materia con giudizio sano, curiosità, adattabilità e una mentalità collaborativa, traducendo i requisiti normativi ed etici in soluzioni pratiche, business-relevant.

Cosa farai

In qualità di Senior Compliance Expert – Dealing in Securities , Anti-Trust e Fair Competition, le vostre principali responsabilità includono:

- Sostenere la manutenzione e il continuo miglioramento di un quadro di conformità robusto ed efficace, con un focus primario su Dealing in Securities, requisiti SIX rilevanti, Anti-Trust e Fair Competition

- Fornire consigli di conformità di esperti, input e orientamento sul trattamento di account personale, barriere informative, condotta di mercato, requisiti SIX pertinenti, antitrust e temi di concorrenza equa per gli stakeholder aziendali e la rete di conformità a livello di gruppo, regionale e locale

- Sviluppare e migliorare l'orientamento, la reportistica, gli approcci di valutazione, la formazione e i materiali di sensibilizzazione e sostenere la loro effettiva attuazione in un modo pragmatico, coinvolgente e imprenditoriale

- Sostenere l'interpretazione e l'applicazione dei requisiti interni e le aspettative di regolamentazione esterna relative alle transazioni sui titoli dei dipendenti, ai conflitti di interesse, ai controlli delle liste e ai rischi di legge sulla concorrenza

- Collaborare a stretto contatto con altre funzioni di assicurazione e controllo, tra cui Legal, Risk e Audit, per supportare una gestione coerente ed efficace dei rischi di conformità rilevanti

- Agire come partner affidabile per gli ufficiali di conformità locali e regionali e sostenere l'interpretazione coerente e l'applicazione dei requisiti in materia di competenze e contesti aziendali

- Impegnarsi con gli stakeholder senior attraverso le Funzioni del Gruppo, comprendere i modelli aziendali, i prodotti, i processi e le iniziative di trasformazione, e contribuire a risultati conformi e sostenibili

- Contribuire alle attività di supervisione, monitoraggio e assicurazione nei settori di competenza pertinenti, tra cui l'identificazione, la valutazione e l'escalation di questioni materiali, se del caso

- Partecipare e sostenere progetti strategici, iniziative di cambiamento normativo e programmi interfunzionali rilevanti per l’area di competenza del ruolo, con agilità nel rispondere agli sviluppi di business, normativi e tecnologici in evoluzione

Cosa porti

In qualità di Senior Compliance Expert – Dealing in Securities , Anti-Trust e Fair Competition, le tue competenze e qualifiche saranno idealmente includere:

- Almeno 8 anni di esperienza professionale pertinente nel trattare in titoli, conformità dei titoli, condotta di mercato, Anti-Trust, Fair Competition o più ampia conformità o ruoli legali, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente complesso e internazionale

- Forte conoscenza delle leggi, dei regolamenti, degli standard industriali e degli sviluppi emergenti, in particolare per quanto riguarda le transazioni sui titoli dei dipendenti, la condotta di mercato, i requisiti SIX rilevanti, l'anti-Trust e la Fair Competition

- Grado universitario in diritto; un grado avanzato o ulteriori qualifiche rilevanti sarebbe un vantaggio

- Forti competenze analitiche e problem solving, con la capacità di valutare le questioni complesse, esercitare il giudizio sonoro, dimostrare l'agilità di apprendimento e la curiosità intellettuale, e tradurre i requisiti in guida pratica

- Capacità di fornire informazioni di gestione chiare e fornire report concisi e di alta qualità per diversi gruppi di stakeholder

- Forte capacità interpersonali, di collaborazione e di gestione degli stakeholder, tra cui credibilità e fiducia nel lavorare con team di senior management e cross-funzionali, e la capacità di costruire relazioni affidabili tra funzioni, culture e livelli di seniority

- Capacità di priorità in modo efficace, navigare nella complessità, lavorare in modo indipendente e fornire ad un elevato standard in un ambiente internazionale dinamico

- Forte comunicazione scritta e verbale, capacità di presentazione e facilitazione

- Buon comando di strumenti di produttività e collaborazione standard, tra cui PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint e Microsoft 365

- Fluente scritto e parlato inglese è essenziale con la lingua aggiunta è un vantaggio

Tu appartieni qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.

Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.

Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.

Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.

Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Mitglied des Compliance-Teams spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Erfüllung des Compliance-Mandats für die Gruppenfunktionen von Zurich, mit besonderem Fokus auf Wertpapierhandel sowie Anti-Trust und fairem Wettbewerb. Zur Unterstützung der strategischen Prioritäten von Zurich ermöglichen Sie Unternehmen und funktionalen Stakeholdern, ihre Ziele konform zu verfolgen, indem Sie pragmatisch beraten, eine starke Compliance-Kultur einbetten und Compliance-Risiken unabhängig bewerten, überwachen und herausfordern.

Der Rolleninhaber ist dafür verantwortlich, zur Entwicklung, Implementierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Compliance-Frameworks in den relevanten Geschäftsbereichen und Funktionen beizutragen, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf dem Handel mit Wertpapieren, einschließlich der relevanten SIX-Anforderungen, sowie dem Anti-Trust und Fairen Wettbewerb liegt. Dazu gehört die Unterstützung bei der Etablierung einer zweckgerechten Anleitung, die Unterstützung einer konsequenten Umsetzung und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem breiten Spektrum von Stakeholdern innerhalb und außerhalb der Group Compliance auf Gruppen-, regionaler und lokaler Ebene.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater kombinieren Sie Fachkompetenz mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen, Neugier, Anpassungsfähigkeit und einer kollaborativen Denkweise und übersetzen regulatorische und ethische Anforderungen in praktische, geschäftsrelevante Lösungen.

Was du tun wirst

Als Senior Compliance Expert – Handel mit Wertpapieren, Anti-Trust und fairem Wettbewerb, werden Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

- Unterstützung der Aufrechterhaltung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung eines robusten und effektiven Compliance-Frameworks mit Schwerpunkt auf Wertpapierhandel, relevanten SIX-Anforderungen, Anti-Trust und fairem Wettbewerb

- Bereitstellung von Experten-Compliance-Beratung, Input und Anleitung zu persönlichen Konten, Informationsbarrieren, Marktverhalten, relevanten SIX-Anforderungen, kartellrechtlichen und fairen Wettbewerbsthemen für Geschäftsbeteiligte und das Compliance-Netzwerk auf Gruppen-, regionaler und lokaler Ebene

- Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Leitlinien, Berichten, Bewertungsansätzen, Schulungs- und Sensibilisierungsmaterialien und Unterstützung ihrer effektiven Umsetzung in der gesamten Organisation auf pragmatische, engagierte und geschäftsrelevante Weise

- Unterstützung der Auslegung und Anwendung interner Anforderungen und externer regulatorischer Erwartungen in Bezug auf Wertpapiertransaktionen von Mitarbeitern, Interessenkonflikte, Kontrolle und eingeschränkte Listenkontrollen sowie wettbewerbsrechtliche Risiken

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Überwachungs- und Kontrollfunktionen, einschließlich Recht, Risiko und Prüfung, zur Unterstützung eines kohärenten und wirksamen Managements relevanter Compliance-Risiken

- Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner für lokale und regionale Compliance-Beauftragte fungieren und eine einheitliche Interpretation und Anwendung von Anforderungen in allen Jurisdiktionen und Geschäftskontexten unterstützen

- Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Stakeholdern in allen Gruppenfunktionen, Verständnis von Geschäftsmodellen, Produkten, Prozessen und Transformationsinitiativen und Beitrag zu konformen und nachhaltigen Ergebnissen

- Beitrag zu Aufsichts-, Überwachungs- und Sicherungstätigkeiten in den einschlägigen Fachgebieten, einschließlich gegebenenfalls Ermittlung, Bewertung und Eskalation wesentlicher Fragen

- Teilnahme an und Unterstützung von strategischen Projekten, Initiativen für regulatorische Veränderungen und funktionsübergreifenden Programmen, die für das Fachgebiet der Rolle relevant sind, mit Agilität bei der Reaktion auf sich entwickelnde Geschäfts-, Regulierungs- und Technologieentwicklungen

Was du mitbringst

Als Senior Compliance Expert – Handel mit Wertpapieren, Anti-Trust und fairem Wettbewerb umfassen Ihre Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen idealerweise:

- Mindestens 8 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit Wertpapieren, Wertpapier-Compliance, Marktverhalten, Anti-Trust, Fair Competition oder breiteren Compliance- oder Rechtsrollen, idealerweise in einem komplexen und internationalen Umfeld

- Kenntnis der einschlägigen Gesetze, Vorschriften, Industriestandards und neuer Entwicklungen, insbesondere in Bezug auf Wertpapiertransaktionen von Mitarbeitern, Marktverhalten, relevante SIX-Anforderungen, Anti-Trust und fairer Wettbewerb

- Universitätsabschluss in Rechtswissenschaften; ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss oder zusätzliche relevante Qualifikationen wären von Vorteil

- Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Angelegenheiten zu beurteilen, ein fundiertes Urteilsvermögen auszuüben, Lernbeweglichkeit und intellektuelle Neugier zu demonstrieren und Anforderungen in praktische Anleitung zu übersetzen

- Fähigkeit, klare Managementinformationen bereitzustellen und eine prägnante, qualitativ hochwertige Berichterstattung für verschiedene Interessengruppen zu liefern

- Starke zwischenmenschliche, kooperative und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, einschließlich Glaubwürdigkeit und Vertrauen in die Arbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung und funktionsübergreifenden Teams sowie die Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen über Funktionen, Kulturen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg aufzubauen

- Fähigkeit, effektiv zu priorisieren, Komplexität zu navigieren, unabhängig zu arbeiten und in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld einen hohen Standard zu liefern

- Starke schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation, Präsentation und Erleichterung Fähigkeiten

- Gute Beherrschung von Standard-Tools für Produktivität und Zusammenarbeit, einschließlich PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint und Microsoft 365

- Fließend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch ist unerlässlich, wobei die Zusatzsprache ein Vorteil ist

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.

Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.

Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.

Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que membre de l'équipe de conformité, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'exécution du mandat de conformité aux fonctions du groupe Zurich, en mettant l'accent sur la négociation de titres ainsi que sur la lutte contre la confiance et la concurrence loyale. En soutien aux priorités stratégiques de Zurich, vous permettrez aux entreprises et aux acteurs fonctionnels de poursuivre leurs objectifs de manière conforme en fournissant des conseils pragmatiques, en aidant à intégrer une culture de conformité forte et en évaluant, en surveillant et en défiant les risques de conformité de manière indépendante.

Le titulaire du rôle est chargé de contribuer à l'élaboration, à la mise en oeuvre et à l'amélioration continue du cadre de conformité dans l'ensemble des entreprises et des fonctions pertinentes, en mettant l'accent sur la négociation de titres, y compris les exigences SIX pertinentes, ainsi que sur la lutte contre la confiance et la concurrence loyale. Il s'agit notamment de contribuer à l'élaboration d'orientations adaptées aux besoins, d'appuyer une mise en œuvre cohérente et de travailler en étroite collaboration avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, tant au sein du groupe qu'à l'extérieur, aux niveaux régional et local.

En tant que conseiller de confiance, vous combinerez l'expertise thématique avec un jugement solide, la curiosité, l'adaptabilité et un état d'esprit collaboratif, transformant les exigences réglementaires et éthiques en solutions pratiques et pertinentes pour les entreprises.

Ce que vous ferez

En tant qu'expert principal en conformité – Commerce de valeurs mobilières , anti-fidélité et concurrence équitable, vos principales responsabilités comprendront :

- Soutenir le maintien et l'amélioration continue d'un cadre de conformité robuste et efficace, en mettant l'accent principalement sur le traitement des titres, les exigences SIX pertinentes, la lutte contre la confiance et la concurrence loyale

- Fournir des conseils, des commentaires et des conseils d'experts en matière de conformité sur les transactions relatives aux comptes personnels, les obstacles à l'information, la conduite du marché, les exigences SIX pertinentes, la lutte contre les ententes et la concurrence loyale aux intervenants commerciaux et au réseau de conformité à tous les niveaux, régional et local

- Élaborer et améliorer les directives, les rapports, les méthodes d ' évaluation, les supports de formation et de sensibilisation et les appuyer efficacement dans l ' ensemble de l ' organisation d ' une manière pragmatique, engageante et pertinente pour les entreprises

- Appui à l'interprétation et à l'application des exigences internes et des attentes réglementaires externes relatives aux opérations sur titres des employés, aux conflits d'intérêts, aux contrôles de surveillance et aux listes restreintes et aux risques liés au droit de la concurrence

- Collaborer étroitement avec d'autres fonctions d'assurance et de contrôle, y compris les fonctions juridiques, de risque et d'audit, afin d'appuyer une gestion cohérente et efficace des risques de conformité pertinents

- Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance auprès des agents de conformité locaux et régionaux et appuyer l'interprétation et l'application cohérentes des exigences dans les administrations et les contextes opérationnels

- Collaborer avec les principaux intervenants dans l'ensemble des fonctions du groupe, comprendre les modèles d'affaires, les produits, les processus et les initiatives de transformation, et contribuer à des résultats conformes et durables

- Contribution aux activités de contrôle, de suivi et d ' assurance dans les domaines de compétence pertinents, y compris l ' identification, l ' évaluation et l ' escalade des problèmes matériels, le cas échéant

- Participation et appui à des projets stratégiques, à des initiatives de changement de réglementation et à des programmes interfonctionnels ayant un rapport avec le domaine d'expertise, avec la souplesse nécessaire pour faire face à l'évolution des activités commerciales, réglementaires et technologiques

Ce que vous apportez

En tant qu'expert principal en conformité – Commerce de valeurs mobilières, anti-fidélité et concurrence équitable, vos compétences et qualifications comprendront idéalement:

- Au moins 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans le domaine du commerce des valeurs mobilières, de la conformité aux valeurs mobilières, de la conduite du marché, de la lutte contre la confiance, de la concurrence loyale ou de la conformité élargie ou des rôles juridiques, idéalement dans un environnement complexe et international

- Forte connaissance des lois, des règlements, des normes de l'industrie et des faits nouveaux pertinents, en particulier en ce qui concerne les opérations sur titres des employés, la conduite du marché, les exigences SIX pertinentes, la lutte contre la confiance et la concurrence loyale

- Diplôme universitaire en droit; un diplôme avancé ou des qualifications supplémentaires pertinentes seraient un avantage

- Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité d'évaluer des questions complexes, d'exercer un bon jugement, de démontrer l'agilité d'apprentissage et la curiosité intellectuelle, et de traduire les exigences en conseils pratiques

- Capacité de fournir des informations de gestion claires et de fournir des rapports concis et de qualité aux différents groupes d'intervenants

- Fortes compétences en relations interpersonnelles, en collaboration et en gestion des intervenants, y compris crédibilité et confiance dans la collaboration avec la haute direction et les équipes interfonctionnelles, et capacité d'établir des relations de confiance entre les fonctions, les cultures et les niveaux d'ancienneté

- Aptitude à établir des priorités efficaces, à naviguer dans la complexité, à travailler de façon indépendante et à atteindre un niveau élevé dans un environnement international dynamique

- Compétences solides en communication écrite et verbale, présentation et facilitation

- Bonne maîtrise des outils standard de productivité et de collaboration, y compris PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint et Microsoft 365

- L'anglais écrit et parlé est essentiel, la langue ajoutée étant un avantage

Tu es ici.

Imaginez travailler dans l'un des lieux de travail les plus durables du monde. Au campus Quai Zurich , vous profiterez d'un environnement conçu pour vous aider à prospérer, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des occasions de se produire à votre meilleur, entouré de talents et de collègues de soutien.

Vous aurez accès à des options alimentaires saines, des installations de remise en forme et des espaces de collaboration lumineux qui stimulent la créativité. Situé au cœur de Zurich sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport en commun, ce qui facilite votre trajet.

Développez avec nous grâce à l'accès aux ressources d'apprentissage, au développement en cours d'emploi et à l'autonomisation et au soutien continus. Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée ensemble un avenir meilleur.

À propos de nous

Zurich est un assureur multiligne leader, desservant plus de 82 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires avec plus de 65 000 employés.

Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance en offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.

Guidée par notre objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir meilleur », nous visons à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes du monde.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne aujourd'hui!

jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Trade Sanctions 80-100%
jobs.description:
As a Legal Counsel – Trade Sanctions, you will step into a newly created role in Group Legal as a key legal advisor to the business on sanctions-related matters. As part of a collaborative, international team of lawyers, you will contribute your legal expertise to protect and enable the Group's business worldwide, shaping how Zurich navigates one of the most dynamic and geopolitically sensitive areas of international regulation. You will support Group Legal in safeguarding our global operations against sanctions-related risks, by providing practical, cross-border legal advice, monitor rapidly evolving international sanctions regimes (EU, UK, US, CH), and supporting the design and deployment of risk-mitigation strategies.

What you will do

Your main responsibilities will be to:

- Provide legal advice and conduct legal research to deliver practical, goal-oriented solutions to relevant stakeholders on complex, multi-jurisdictional sanctions-related matters.

- Support investigations of potential sanctions breaches, coordinating with external counsel and regulators where necessary.

- Proactively identify key trends and developments in the sanctions space (UN, EU, US, UK, Switzerland) and support translating them into practical advice for the business.

- Partner with Compliance and other functions, advising and contributing the legal perspective to shape internal guidelines, policies and the Group's approach to sanctions.

- Manage sanctions documentation, tracking and follow-up, including maintaining sanctions clauses and shared knowledge resources.

- Support the Sanctions Lawyers Network, especially in preparing updates and managing information flows among participants.

- Support any other topics on an ad hoc basis within the remit of the Corporate Center Legal team.

What you bring

- Master's degree in Law or equivalent professional legal qualification in an EU/UK/US jurisdiction. Bar admission is a plus.

- At least 2-4+ years of relevant professional experience at an international law firm or in-house legal department, with experience involving trade sanctions, AML or international business law.

- Strong familiarity with and understanding of the sanctions regimes most relevant to our business, particularly EU, UK, US, Swiss frameworks.

- Clear, concise and accurate drafting skills, with the ability to translate complex legal concepts into practical, user-friendly guidance for different audiences.

- Proactive autonomous and pragmatic mindset, with strong ownership and the ability to develop risk-based, business-oriented solutions.

- High integrity and sound judgement, with the ability to remain composed and professional when managing sensitive or time-critical matters.

- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across functions and at all levels.

- Excellent analytical, verbal and written communication skills, combined with strong legal instincts and outstanding issue-spotting ability.

- Ability to handle multiple competing tasks and priorities, staying resourceful and composed under pressure, with excellent organizational and project management skills.

- Excellent command of English is essential; additional languages are a plus.

- Familiarity with legal and risk management software.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di consulente legale – Trade Sanctions, si entrerà in un nuovo ruolo nel Gruppo Legale come consulente legale chiave per l'azienda su questioni relative alle sanzioni. Nell'ambito di un team collaborativo e internazionale di avvocati, contribuirai alla tua competenza legale per proteggere e abilitare il business del Gruppo in tutto il mondo, plasmando come Zurigo naviga in una delle aree più dinamiche e geopoliticamente sensibili della regolamentazione internazionale. Sosterrete il Gruppo Legale nella salvaguardia delle nostre operazioni globali contro i rischi legati alle sanzioni, fornendo consulenza legale pratica e transfrontaliera, monitorando i regimi di sanzioni internazionali in rapida evoluzione (UE, Regno Unito, Stati Uniti, CH), e sostenendo la progettazione e l'implementazione di strategie di riduzione dei rischi.

Cosa farai

Le vostre principali responsabilità saranno:

- Fornire consulenza legale e condurre ricerche legali per fornire soluzioni pratiche e orientate all'obiettivo per le parti interessate rilevanti su questioni complesse e multi-giurisdizionali.

- Sostenere le indagini sulle potenziali violazioni delle sanzioni, coordinando con i consulenti esterni e i regolatori, se necessario.

- Identificare attivamente le tendenze e gli sviluppi chiave nello spazio delle sanzioni (ONU, UE, Stati Uniti, Regno Unito, Svizzera) e il supporto traducendoli in consigli pratici per l'azienda.

- Partner con Compliance e altre funzioni, consigliando e contribuendo alla prospettiva legale di modellare le linee guida interne, le politiche e l'approccio del Gruppo alle sanzioni.

- Gestire la documentazione delle sanzioni, il monitoraggio e il follow-up, compreso il mantenimento di clausole di sanzioni e risorse di conoscenza condivise.

- Sostenere la rete di avvocati di sanzioni, in particolare nella preparazione di aggiornamenti e gestione dei flussi di informazioni tra i partecipanti.

- Sostenere qualsiasi altro argomento su una base ad hoc all'interno del mandato del team Corporate Center Legal.

Cosa porti

- Laurea magistrale in Giurisprudenza o qualifica professionale equivalente in una giurisdizione UE/UK/US. L'ammissione al bar è un vantaggio.

- Almeno 2-4 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante in uno studio legale internazionale o in-house dipartimento legale, con esperienza che coinvolge sanzioni commerciali, AML o diritto commerciale internazionale.

- Forte familiarità con e comprensione dei regimi di sanzioni più rilevanti per la nostra attività, in particolare UE, Regno Unito, Stati Uniti, quadri svizzeri.

- Competenze di redazione chiare, concise e accurate, con la capacità di tradurre concetti legali complessi in una guida pratica e facile da usare per il pubblico diverso.

- Proattiva mentalità autonoma e pragmatica, con una forte proprietà e la capacità di sviluppare soluzioni orientate al rischio e al business.

- Alta integrità e giudizio sonoro, con la capacità di rimanere composto e professionale quando si gestiscono questioni sensibili o puntuali.

- Forte capacità interpersonali, con la capacità di costruire relazioni di lavoro efficaci attraverso funzioni e a tutti i livelli.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione analitica, verbale e scritta, combinata con forti istinti legali e eccezionale capacità di emissione-spotting.

- Capacità di gestire più compiti e priorità concorrenti, rimanendo pieno di risorse e composto sotto pressione, con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto.

- Ottimo comando dell'inglese è essenziale; lingue aggiuntive sono un plus.

- Familiarità con software legale e di gestione dei rischi.

Tu appartieni qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.
Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.
Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Rechtsberater – Handelssanktionen treten Sie in eine neu geschaffene Rolle in Group Legal als wichtiger Rechtsberater für das Unternehmen in Sanktionsfragen ein. Als Teil eines kollaborativen, internationalen Teams von Anwälten bringen Sie Ihre juristische Expertise ein, um das Geschäft der Gruppe weltweit zu schützen und zu ermöglichen und zu gestalten, wie Zurich einen der dynamischsten und geopolitisch sensibelsten Bereiche der internationalen Regulierung steuert. Sie unterstützen Group Legal bei der Absicherung unserer globalen Aktivitäten gegen Sanktionsrisiken, indem Sie praktische, grenzüberschreitende Rechtsberatung anbieten, sich schnell entwickelnde internationale Sanktionsregelungen (EU, UK, USA, CH) überwachen und die Konzeption und Umsetzung von Risikominderungsstrategien unterstützen.

Was du tun wirst

Ihre Hauptaufgaben sind:

- Bereitstellung von Rechtsberatung und Durchführung von Rechtsrecherchen, um den relevanten Interessengruppen praktische, zielgerichtete Lösungen für komplexe, strafrechtliche Sanktionen zu liefern.

- Unterstützung bei der Untersuchung möglicher Verstöße gegen Sanktionen und gegebenenfalls Koordinierung mit externen Beratern und Regulierungsbehörden.

- Identifizieren Sie proaktiv wichtige Trends und Entwicklungen im Sanktionsbereich (UN, EU, USA, Großbritannien, Schweiz) und unterstützen Sie deren Umsetzung in praktische Beratung für das Unternehmen.

- Partnerschaft mit Compliance und anderen Funktionen, Beratung und Einbringung der rechtlichen Perspektive zur Gestaltung interner Richtlinien, Richtlinien und des Sanktionsansatzes der Gruppe.

- Verwaltung der Sanktionsdokumentation, Nachverfolgung und Nachverfolgung, einschließlich der Beibehaltung von Sanktionsklauseln und gemeinsamer Wissensressourcen.

- Unterstützen Sie das Netzwerk für Rechtsanwälte, insbesondere bei der Vorbereitung von Updates und der Verwaltung des Informationsflusses zwischen den Teilnehmern.

- Unterstützen Sie alle anderen Themen auf Ad-hoc-Basis im Rahmen des Corporate Center Legal-Teams.

Was du mitbringst

- Master-Abschluss in Rechtswissenschaften oder gleichwertige berufliche juristische Qualifikation in einer EU / UK / US-Jurisdiktion. Bar-Eintritt ist ein Plus.

- Mindestens 2-4+ Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einer internationalen Anwaltskanzlei oder einer internen Rechtsabteilung mit Erfahrung in Bezug auf Handelssanktionen, AML oder internationales Wirtschaftsrecht.

- Starke Vertrautheit und Verständnis der für unser Geschäft wichtigsten Sanktionsregelungen, insbesondere der EU, des Vereinigten Königreichs, der USA und der Schweiz.

- Klare, prägnante und genaue redaktionelle Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Konzepte in praktische, benutzerfreundliche Anleitung für verschiedene Zielgruppen zu übersetzen.

- Proaktive autonome und pragmatische Denkweise mit starker Eigenverantwortung und der Fähigkeit, risikobasierte, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.

- Hohe Integrität und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen, mit der Fähigkeit, bei der Verwaltung sensibler oder zeitkritischer Angelegenheiten zusammengesetzt und professionell zu bleiben.

- Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektive Arbeitsbeziehungen über Funktionen und auf allen Ebenen aufzubauen.

- Hervorragende analytische, verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, kombiniert mit starken rechtlichen Instinkten und hervorragenden Problemerkennungsfähigkeiten.

- Fähigkeit, mehrere konkurrierende Aufgaben und Prioritäten zu bewältigen, einfallsreich und unter Druck mit hervorragenden organisatorischen und Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten zu bleiben.

- Hervorragende Englischkenntnisse sind unerlässlich; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Plus.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que conseiller juridique – Sanctions commerciales, vous entrerez dans un nouveau rôle au sein de Group Legal en tant que conseiller juridique clé de l'entreprise sur les questions liées aux sanctions. Dans le cadre d'une équipe internationale collaborative d'avocats, vous apporterez votre expertise juridique pour protéger et permettre l'activité du Groupe dans le monde entier, façonnant la façon dont Zurich navigue dans l'un des domaines les plus dynamiques et géopolitiquement sensibles de la réglementation internationale. Vous aiderez Group Legal à protéger nos opérations mondiales contre les risques liés aux sanctions, en fournissant des conseils juridiques pratiques et transfrontaliers, en surveillant l'évolution rapide des régimes de sanctions internationales (UE, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, CH) et en soutenant la conception et le déploiement de stratégies d'atténuation des risques.

Ce que vous ferez

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

- Fournir des conseils juridiques et mener des recherches juridiques afin d'apporter des solutions pratiques et axées sur des objectifs aux parties intéressées sur des questions complexes et multigouvernementales liées aux sanctions.

- Appuyer les enquêtes sur les infractions potentielles aux sanctions, en coordination avec les conseils externes et les organismes de réglementation, au besoin.

- Identifier de manière proactive les principales tendances et évolutions dans l'espace des sanctions (ONU, UE, États-Unis, Royaume-Uni, Suisse) et soutenir leur traduction en conseils pratiques pour l'entreprise.

- S'associer au respect et à d'autres fonctions, conseiller et contribuer à la perspective juridique afin d'élaborer des lignes directrices internes, des politiques et l'approche du Groupe en matière de sanctions.

- Gérer la documentation, le suivi et le suivi des sanctions, y compris le maintien des clauses de sanctions et des ressources de connaissances partagées.

- Appuyer le Réseau des avocats en matière de sanctions, en particulier dans la préparation des mises à jour et la gestion des flux d'information entre les participants.

- Soutenir tout autre sujet sur une base ad hoc relevant de la compétence de l'équipe juridique du Corporate Center.

Ce que vous apportez

- Maîtrise en droit ou qualification juridique professionnelle équivalente dans une juridiction UE/Royaume-Uni/États-Unis. L'admission au barreau est un plus.

- Au moins 2 à 4 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un cabinet d'avocats ou un service juridique interne, avec une expérience en matière de sanctions commerciales, de LAM ou de droit commercial international.

- Une grande connaissance et compréhension des régimes de sanctions les plus pertinents pour notre entreprise, en particulier l'UE, le Royaume-Uni, les États-Unis et la Suisse.

- Compétences de rédaction claires, concises et précises, capables de traduire des concepts juridiques complexes en orientations pratiques et conviviales pour différents publics.

- Un état d'esprit autonome et pragmatique proactif, avec une forte appropriation et la capacité de développer des solutions axées sur le risque et orientées vers l'entreprise.

- Haute intégrité et jugement sain, avec la capacité de rester composé et professionnel lors de la gestion des questions sensibles ou critiques du temps.

- Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles, avec la capacité d'établir des relations de travail efficaces entre les fonctions et à tous les niveaux.

- Excellentes compétences en matière d'analyse, de communication verbale et écrite, associées à de solides instincts juridiques et à une capacité exceptionnelle de pointage des questions.

- Capacité de gérer plusieurs tâches et priorités concurrentes, en restant débrouillard et composé sous pression, avec d'excellentes compétences en gestion d'organisation et de projet.

- Une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle; les langues supplémentaires sont un plus.

- Connaissance des logiciels juridiques et de gestion des risques.

Tu es ici.

Imaginez travailler dans l'un des lieux de travail les plus durables du monde. Au campus Quai Zurich , vous profiterez d'un environnement conçu pour vous aider à prospérer, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des occasions de se produire à votre meilleur, entouré de talents et de collègues de soutien.
Vous aurez accès à des options alimentaires saines, des installations de remise en forme et des espaces de collaboration lumineux qui stimulent la créativité. Situé au cœur de Zurich sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport en commun, ce qui facilite votre trajet.
Développez avec nous grâce à l'accès aux ressources d'apprentissage, au développement en cours d'emploi et à l'autonomisation et au soutien continus. Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée ensemble un avenir meilleur.

À propos de nous

Zurich est un assureur multiligne leader, desservant plus de 82 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires avec plus de 65 000 employés.
Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance en offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.
Guidée par notre objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir meilleur », nous visons à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes du monde.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne aujourd'hui!

jobs.title: Senior Underwriter / Underwriter (Middle Market / Commercial Insurance)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

- Responsible for multi-lines business but mainly to focus on Property & Casualty portfolios KPIs performance of the Hong Kong Business Unit focusing on Mid-Market domestic business

- Underwrite and analyze new and renewal business within delegated authority levels

- Develop and maintain relationships with brokers and other distributors in support of business retention and acquisition and work with customers and distributors to determine their insurance related needs & provide solutions, and contribute to the development of propositions

Job Accountabilities

- Maintain profitable multi-lines underwriting for Mid-market portfolios and provide training to other associates including the administrative assistant

- Apply all Underwriting elements for new business & renewals in handling the assignments of the highest complexity and works within delegated authorities, measuring exposure & analyzing risk, determining technical price according to certified/agreed pricing process, quoting & setting coverage, negotiating terms & conditions

- Contribute to managing accounts; build relationships in support of customer/ business acquisition and retention (e.g. by handling a range of queries, providing advice to assist with the development of an account; implementing agreed technical standards, controls, practices and procedures, thereby maintaining underwriting discipline

- Timely update and use of Underwriting Scorecards and other MI tools & processes to proactively manage and improve the portfolios mix & performance and pipelines management

Job Qualifications

- Degree holder

- Minimum 2 years working experience in General Insurance program

- Good multi-lines underwriting knowledge mainly on Property & Casualty business

- Good knowledge & experience in evaluating middle market exposures as well as directing and assisting others in analyzing unusual risks

- Experience & knowledge in negotiating mid-market deals; demonstrate in-depth experience with middle market customers and delivering customer service options

- Proven experience in troubleshooting and overcoming difficult issues with brokers and creating and delivering programs for addressing the needs of multiple or large producers

- To be a team player

- Fluency in English & Cantonese; Mandarin-speaking is an added advantage

- Excellent negotiation, influencing and selling skills – internal and external - Ability to develop strong relationships with key business partners whilst maximizing Company’s profitable growth objective

- Ability to build trust & business relationships with customers and producers.

- Open mind to try new ways and alternative approaches of doing things

- Self-starter, proactive, results and execution oriented

- Candidates with more solid Underwriting experiences will be considered for other positions

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Location(s): HK - Hong Kong

- Remote working: Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Risk Engineering Consultant- Construction Casualty
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant for the Casualty Lines of Business in our Southern region. This is a Remote work from home role. The preferred region is either middle to southern Texas , or also Eastern Tennessee, with additional consideration given to Northern Georgia and the western areas of both North and South Carolina. Travel may be required across these states within the designated territory. We would also like to see some experience with both Regulated and Non-Regulated Fleets and Data Center construction.

The position includes a company car, with expected travel of 30% to 50% of your time depending on business needs.

In this role as a Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant, you will be responsible for:

- Adapting Zurich's Innovative Solutions to the Construction Industry with the objective of minimizing impacts to customer losses, and overall improvement of Sustainability & Business Resiliency at the Corporate Level.

- Leveraging Zurich’s risk engineering tools and services to improve customer risk and general account management of customers who purchase Zurich Construction Insurance products such as: Workers Compensation, General Liability and Auto Liability.

- Delivering high quality construction consultative services for customers, including identifying exposures and program risk control gaps to form the basis of risk mitigation recommendations, investigation of cause/effect of major losses for hazard/safety management programs.

- Developing and maintaining positive customer and business partner relationships and collaborate with both customers and business partners to develop appropriate service plans.

- Marketing and selling a wide range of fee services to customers that support their risk mitigation efforts.

- Producing advanced level presentations and delivering risk management training for customers and internal business partners.

- Providing appropriate risk improvement advice, conduct loss investigations (including both trend and root cause analysis), and implement risk improvement programs.

- Assisting customers with developing corporate and project specific QA/QC plans, safety plans, investigating construction defects when applicable, building envelope reviews and moisture mitigation identification.

- Participate in Sales Team meetings and presentations to brokers and customers while contributing to fee income sales through opportunity spotting and cross-selling.

Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) background check because this position will include a company car.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Construction Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, or Construction Field Operations.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Construction Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, or Construction Field Operations.
AND

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Construction Safety/Risk preferrable with Project Management, and/or Superintendent experience- mid to senior level position.

- Regulated and Non-Regulated Fleet Experience

- Data Center construction experience

- Large commercial construction experience with industrial, medical, and educational projects.

- Advanced level knowledge of construction safety, operations, quality management and associated construction risks and exposures.

- Professional certifications such as: CRIS, ARM, CHST, CSP, ASP, P.E. etc.

- Have a high level of computer literacy and be proficient in Microsoft Office and IOS platforms.

- Proficiency in technical writing to create customer and internal business partner work products.

- Be experienced working in both independent and team environments.

- Excellent interpersonal, communication and consulting skills with the ability to communicate and consult at both the corporate and project site levels effectively and professionally.

- Leadership and involvement in extracurricular activities, organizations and/or community, public service, or similar activities.

- Willingness to embrace the Zurich Basics, including our values of integrity, Sustainability, Customer Centricity, Excellence and Teamwork.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. Zurich is currently looking for a Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant for the Casualty Lines of Business in our Southern region. This is a Remote work from home role. In this role as a Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant, you will be responsible for:

- Adapting Zurich's Innovative Solutions to the Construction Industry with the objective of minimizing impacts to customer losses, and overall improvement of Sustainability & Business Resiliency at the Corporate Level.

- Leveraging Zurich’s risk engineering tools and services to improve customer risk and general account management of customers who purchase Zurich Construction Insurance products such as: Workers Compensation, General Liability and Auto Liability.

- Delivering high quality construction consultative services for customers, including identifying exposures and program risk control gaps to form the basis of risk mitigation recommendations, investigation of cause/effect of major losses for hazard/safety management programs.

- Developing and maintaining positive customer and business partner relationships and collaborate with both customers and business partners to develop appropriate service plans.

- Marketing and selling a wide range of fee services to customers that support their risk mitigation efforts.

- Producing advanced level presentations and delivering risk management training for customers and internal business partners.

- Providing appropriate risk improvement advice, conduct loss investigations (including both trend and root cause analysis), and implement risk improvement programs.

- Assisting customers with developing corporate and project specific QA/QC plans, safety plans, investigating construction defects when applicable, building envelope reviews and moisture mitigation identification.

- Participate in Sales Team meetings and presentations to brokers and customers while contributing to fee income sales through opportunity spotting and cross-selling.

Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) background check because this position will include a company car.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Construction Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, or Construction Field Operations.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Construction Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, or Construction Field Operations.
AND

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Construction Safety/Risk preferrable with Project Management, and/or Superintendent experience- mid to senior level position.

- Regulated and Non-Regulated Fleet Experience

- Data Center construction experience

- Large commercial construction experience with industrial, medical, and educational projects.

- Advanced level knowledge of construction safety, operations, quality management and associated construction risks and exposures.

- Professional certifications such as: CRIS, ARM, CHST, CSP, ASP, P.E. etc.

- Have a high level of computer literacy and be proficient in Microsoft Office and IOS platforms.

- Proficiency in technical writing to create customer and internal business partner work products.

- Be experienced working in both independent and team environments.

- Excellent interpersonal, communication and consulting skills with the ability to communicate and consult at both the corporate and project site levels effectively and professionally.

- Leadership and involvement in extracurricular activities, organizations and/or community, public service, or similar activities.

jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a Construction Risk Engineer Consultant for the Casualty Lines of Business. This is a Minnesota based remote role supporting the upper Midwest region. Ideal location includes Minneapolis and surrounding areas. The position includes a company car, with expected travel of 30% to 50% and overnight travel of 20% to 30% of your time depending on business needs. This role could be filled at either a Risk Engineering Consultant or at the Sr. Risk Engineering Consultant level, this will be at the manager’s discretion.

As a Construction Risk Engineering Consultant, you will be responsible for:

- Apply Zurich risk engineering solutions to construction customers to help reduce losses and improve risk management outcomes.

- Leverage Zurich’s risk engineering tools and services to improve customer risk and general account management of customers who purchase Zurich Construction Insurance products such as: Workers Compensation, General Liability and Auto Liability.

- Deliver high-quality consultative services, including exposure identification, evaluation of risk control gaps, and development of practical risk mitigation recommendations.

- Develop and maintain positive customer and business partner relationships, collaborating to create appropriate service plans.

- Partner with Construction Underwriting to evaluate and assess existing and prospective customers.

- Identify opportunities to provide fee-based services that support customer risk mitigation and performance improvement efforts.

- Develop and deliver advanced presentations and risk management training for customers and internal business partners.

- Providing appropriate risk improvement advice, conduct loss investigations (including both trend and root cause analysis), and implementing risk improvement programs.

- Assist customers with corporate and project specific safety plans, QA/QC programs, construction defect investigations when applicable, building envelope reviews, and moisture mitigation strategies.

- Actively participate and engage in local construction industry associations.

Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle record background check, because this position will include a company car.

Basic Qualifications:

Risk Engineering Consultant:

- Bachelors Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area
OR

- Zurich Certified Apprentice, including an Associates degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area
AND

- Experience working in a team environment

- Relevant experience in the assessment of risk, based on what is required by LOB specific competency standards

OR

Senior Risk Engineering Consultant:

- Bachelors Degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, Construction Field Operations, Engineering or relatable field.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, Construction Field Operations, Engineering or relatable field.
OR

- Zurich Certified Apprentice, including an Associates degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, Construction Field Operations, Engineering, or relatable field.
AND

Preferred Qualifications:

- Advanced knowledge of construction safety, operations, quality management, and associated risks, exposures and controls.

- Experience with large commercial construction, data center construction, and regulated or non-regulated fleets.

- Strong technical writing and presentation skills for customer-facing and internal work products.

- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and consulting skills with the ability to engage effectively at both corporate and project site levels.

- Have a high level of computer literacy and be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Copilot, and mobile IOS devices.

- Professional certifications: CHST, ASP, CSP, CRIS, ARM

- Relevant experience as a corporate safety professional, site safety leader, project manager, or superintendent with safety responsibilities.

- Demonstrated leadership and involvement in professional, community, or public service activities.

- Willingness to embrace Zurich Basics, including our values of integrity, sustainability, customer centricity, excellence, and teamwork.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. La position comprend une voiture d'entreprise, avec un voyage prévu de 30% à 50% et un voyage de nuit de 20% à 30% de votre temps selon les besoins d'affaires. Ce rôle pourrait être assumé soit par un consultant en génie des risques, soit par un consultant en génie des risques, à la discrétion du gestionnaire.

En tant que consultant en génie des risques de construction, vous serez responsable de :

- Appliquer des solutions d'ingénierie des risques à Zurich aux clients de la construction pour aider à réduire les pertes et améliorer les résultats de gestion des risques.

- Tirer parti des outils et services d'ingénierie des risques de Zurich pour améliorer le risque client et la gestion générale des comptes des clients qui achètent des produits d'assurance de la construction de Zurich tels que: Indemnisation des accidents du travail, responsabilité générale et responsabilité automobile.

- Fournir des services consultatifs de haute qualité, y compris l'identification de l'exposition, l'évaluation des lacunes en matière de contrôle des risques et l'élaboration de recommandations pratiques en matière d'atténuation des risques.

- Développer et maintenir des relations positives avec les clients et les partenaires commerciaux, en collaborant à la création de plans de service appropriés.

- Partenaire avec Construction Underwriting pour évaluer et évaluer les clients existants et potentiels.

- Déterminer les possibilités de fournir des services payants qui appuient les efforts d'atténuation des risques et d'amélioration du rendement des clients.

- Élaborer et offrir des présentations avancées et une formation en gestion des risques pour les clients et les partenaires commerciaux internes.

- Fournir des conseils appropriés sur l'amélioration des risques, mener des enquêtes sur les pertes (y compris l'analyse des tendances et des causes profondes) et mettre en oeuvre des programmes d'amélioration des risques.

- Aider les clients à élaborer des plans de sécurité, des programmes d'AQ/CQ, des enquêtes sur les défauts de construction, le cas échéant, des examens de l'enveloppe du bâtiment et des stratégies d'atténuation de l'humidité.

- Participation active aux associations locales de l'industrie de la construction.

Les candidats finals feront également l'objet d'une vérification des antécédents des dossiers des véhicules automobiles, car ce poste comprendra une voiture de compagnie.

Qualifications de base :

Conseiller en génie des risques :

- Baccalauréat et 3 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des risques
OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 5 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des risques
OU

- Zurich Apprenti certifié, y compris un diplôme d'associé et 3 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des risques
PAYS

- Expérience de travail en équipe

- Expérience pertinente dans l'évaluation du risque, en fonction de ce qui est exigé par les normes de compétence spécifiques de la LOB

OU

Conseiller principal en génie du risque :

- Baccalauréat et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des risques, de la sécurité/gestion des risques, des opérations sur le terrain de la construction, de l'ingénierie ou du domaine relatable.
OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des risques, de la sécurité/gestion des risques, des opérations sur le terrain de la construction, de l'ingénierie ou du domaine relatable.
OU

- Apprentis agréé de Zurich, comprenant un diplôme d'associé et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'ingénierie des risques, de la sécurité/gestion des risques, des opérations sur le terrain de la construction, de l'ingénierie ou du domaine relatable.
PAYS

Qualifications préférées :

- Connaissance avancée de la sécurité, des opérations, de la gestion de la qualité et des risques, expositions et contrôles associés.

- Expérience de la construction commerciale, de la construction de centres de données et de flottes réglementées ou non réglementées.

- Fortes compétences techniques en rédaction et en présentation pour les produits de travail orientés vers le client et internes.

- Excellentes compétences en relations interpersonnelles, en communication et en consultation avec la capacité de s'engager efficacement au niveau de l'entreprise et du site du projet.

- Avoir un niveau élevé de connaissances en informatique et être compétent en Microsoft Office, y compris Copilot, et les appareils mobiles IOS.

- Certifications professionnelles : TCSPS, ASP, CSP, CRIS, ARM

- Expérience pertinente en tant que professionnel de la sécurité de l'entreprise, chef de la sécurité du site, gestionnaire de projet ou surintendant chargé de la sécurité.

- Leadership démontré et participation à des activités professionnelles, communautaires ou de la fonction publique.

- Volonté d'embrasser Zurich Basics, y compris nos valeurs d'intégrité, de durabilité, de centricité, d'excellence et de travail d'équipe.

Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont supérieures à la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous. L'échelle de rémunération indiquée est une moyenne nationale et peut varier selon le lieu. L'échelle salariale combinée pour ce poste est de 79 600,00 $ - 172 300,00 $. L'échelle salariale proposée pour le consultant en génie des risques est de 79 600,00 $ - 130 300,00 $, avec une prime incitative à court terme fixée à 10 %. L'échelle salariale proposée pour le consultant principal en génie du risque est de 105 200,00 $ - 172 300,00 $, et l'admissibilité à une prime incitative à court terme est fixée à 15 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

Provide meticulous entry and management of confidential employee data. Maintain accurate and up-to-date personnel-related information, ensuring that HR and management have access to reliable data for decision-making.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

Perform detailed data entry tasks, diligently entering information from various employee records into the HR systems. This may includes personal details, employment history, performance evaluations, training records, and benefits information. Fornire meticoloso ingresso e gestione dei dati riservati dei dipendenti. Mantenere informazioni accurate e aggiornate sul personale, assicurando che le risorse umane e la gestione abbiano accesso a dati affidabili per il processo decisionale.

Capacità di lavoro - Capacità di contabilità chiave

Esegui i compiti di inserimento dei dati dettagliati, diligentemente inserendo informazioni da vari record dei dipendenti nei sistemi HR. jobs.description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there!

I am Laura the recruiter for this position (and hopefully, your future colleague!).

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at ServiZurich: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at the Zurich !

Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading!

First off, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to ServiZurich. Established in Barcelona in 2006, ServiZurich operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In addition to our technological solutions, we excel in investment, administration, and accounting, ensuring comprehensive support for Zurich's diverse operations.

What Can You Expect?

Zurich Global Employee Benefits Solutions (ZGEBS) is a business unit within Zurich Insurance Group whose objective is to support multinational customers in structuring global employee benefits solutions that cover local and/or international employees in multiple countries. ZGEBS manages and operates captive, pooling and International Program (ZIPE) solutions that combine local insurance policies – provided by local Zurich units or selected external partners – into a reinsurance arrangement for multinational customers. These offerings cover employee benefits insurance risks such as death, disability, accident and medical coverages.

We are excited to invite applications to implement our ambitious objective to grow and expand our business around the world.

The Data Analyst works cross functionally with Sales, Underwriting and Finance to deliver key services to out global customers, including portfolio analysis and performance reporting.

You have experience in working in a fast paced international business environment, analytic thinker who likes to solve problems and deliver service excellence in collaboration with different stakeholders. You like to work in a dynamic team where activities are based on capabilities, skills and willingness to help each other.

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at Zurich? I’m glad you asked – I asked myself the same question at the time.

As a Financial Data Analyst you will have the opportunity to:

- Manage relationship and activities related to our Network Partners and Customers

- Producing professional Customer and Network Partners data analytics / reports

- Streamlinining processes and data analysis to ensure excellent delivery standard

- Monitoring portfolio data and performance

- Proactively ensuring customer satisfaction through the monitoring and implementation of related metrics.

- Establishing best practice to optimize end service delivery

- Ensuring financial and accounting closing are performed according to deadlines

- Actively collaborating with other teams and Subject Matter Experts to identify relevant data sources, help develop and improve operational and customer reports

- Work alongside experts in various technological domains.

- Enhance your skills with real-world experience

- Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

- A university degree, preferably in an analytical numerical field (Finance / Accounting, Data Science, Math, or Statistics)

- Relevant work experience of 3-5 years related to the above mentioned responsibilities

- Basic knowledge in the insurance business is preferred.

- Excellent understanding of data administration and management functions (collection, analysis, distribution etc.)

- Ability to work with large data sets across different business segments and extrapolate findings to support decision-making

- Communication, presentation, project management and relationship skills

- Proven experience in financial reporting and/or accounting ; strong understanding of financial data processes is essential.

- Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced Excel knowledge; experience in Power BI or similar data visualization tools preferred.

- English at business fluency lev el (written and spoken), as the role is customer-facing and requires communication with international stakeholders.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage deadlines under pressure.

- Team player with proactive attitude and attention to detail.

And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus , we offer:

- To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.

- Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.

- Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English and Spanish classes depending on the needs.

- Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.

- Life and accident insurance.

- Collective Life retirement Plan

- 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.

- Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts

- Functional diversity benefits

- Different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more

Where Are We Located?

Bac de Roda, Barcelona.

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

Ciao!
