Reporting to the Deputy Vice-President, General Assets, you will act as both an account coordinator and a field representative for several accounts. You will work with underwriting partners to manage the risk quality of the Zurich asset portfolio, support client risk control programs, conduct on-site risk assessments, develop account analysis and coordinate follow-up meetings, while respecting Zurich's global technical standards and recognized codes.

This is a unique opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice counts. The purpose of this posting is to fill an already vacant position.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence technology tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including initial examination and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the only basis for screening or selecting candidates. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified recruitment professionals.

Zurich applies a hybrid work model requiring a presence in person three days a week.

What You Will Do

• Assess the quality of complex risks, focusing on key and strategic assets as defined by Zurich Resilience Solutions standards.
• Evaluate potential losses according to Zurich and industry definitions.
• Support external clients by identifying, assessing and reducing risks related to their key/strategic assets and their overall accounts.
• Provide appropriate risk improvement recommendations, conduct loss investigations (including trend and root cause analysis) and implement risk improvement programs.
• Communicate effectively with risk engineers in the field; maintain relations with underwriting partners, brokers, sector consultants, professional organisations and licensing authorities.
• Develop and implement client service plans for coordinated accounts to support the effectiveness of field services.
• Ensure the consistency and quality of the services provided to the account, including assessments, risk improvement recommendations, reporting, and time and expenditure management.
• Explore new service opportunities, develop new services for customers, and identify cross-sales potential.
• Support the business growth of Zurich Resilience Solutions by providing leading-edge consulting and sales services, identifying opportunities and fostering strong customer relationships.
• Manage change within accounts by maintaining close contact with client management teams and business partners, including reviewing new projects and change plans.

Position qualifications – What You Bring

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree and at least 8 years of experience in property risk engineering
OR
• High school diploma or equivalent and at least 10 years of experience in property risk engineering
OR
• Zurich Certified Apprenticeship Program, including a college degree and at least 8 years of experience in property risk engineering
AND
• Experience with Microsoft Office
• Advanced knowledge of risks and controls in the industrial sector
• Work experience within a team

Assets:
• Bachelor of Engineering, Civil Engineering or Related Discipline
• Risk Management Designation (RMC)
• Experience in managing accounts as a risk management services consultant for medium-sized companies or large clients in insurance of related goods and programs
• Excellent communication skills and strong results-oriented consultation skills
• Excellent collaboration skills
• Mastery of spoken and written French
• Mastery of spoken and written English required to facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders outside Quebec.

Our culture

• At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about diversity, inclusion, fairness and feeling of belonging (DIEB). We want you to be at work yourself and our employees to reflect the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives aim to create an environment where everyone feels welcome.
• We maintain a culture of collaboration where diversity of thought is valued. We value your ideas and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.
• We care about the well-being of our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits and health care plan with different levels of coverage tailored to your needs, as well as a competitive overall compensation program.
• We understand the importance of resting, reloading batteries and doing what we love. At Zurich, all employees benefit from a minimum of four weeks' vacation per year for this purpose.
• We also understand that employees sometimes need leave for personal reasons. You can have an appointment during a working day, a cultural or religious celebration to highlight or simply need time to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees have four personal days per year to use at their discretion.
• We are committed to continuous improvement and provide access to a wide range of training and development opportunities.
• We care about our communities. Our communities are the places where our clients, employees and shareholders live and work. Although we can be proud of Zurich's contribution to society through its core insurance activity, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time and resources.
• We have won many awards for our work culture. We are proud to be one of the top employers in the Greater Toronto Area and to have received the 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award from Insurance Business Canada.

Make a difference. Raise challenges. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work with us.

About us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-branch insurer with approximately 55,000 global employees serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada is a major insurance provider that has served medium-sized and large companies, including multinationals, in the Canadian business insurance market for 100 years. With more than 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a major insurer, combined with a thorough knowledge of local business sectors and markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be the first choice for risk management professionals as a reference partner to help them meet the risks challenges of today and tomorrow. For more information, visit www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich leads to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We welcome talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion brig us closer to our common goal: exeeding our customers Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on need of, Zurich. We strike to a worker free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited findings from search firm or employment agencies. Any unsolicited summary will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred seller, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for summary submission.

Gelegenheiten

Suchen Sie einen fürsorglichen, kollaborativen und werteorientierten Arbeitsplatz mit inspirierenden Kollegen und Führungskräften? Haben Sie den Ehrgeiz und den Wunsch, zu den Besten zu gehören und im einflussreichsten Versicherungsanbieter der Welt zu gedeihen? Suchen Sie nicht weiter als Zürich Kanada.

Wenn Sie Erfahrung im Asset Risk Management haben und eine neue Herausforderung suchen, treffen wir Sie gerne.

Zurich Canada ist derzeit auf der Suche nach einem stellvertretenden Vizepräsidenten, Senior Asset Risk Management Consultant, der Experten für Risikobewertung und Beratungsdienstleistungen zur Unterstützung unserer Asset-bezogenen Hochrisikokonten bereitstellt.

Berichterstattung an den stellvertretenden Vizepräsidenten, General Assets, werden Sie sowohl als Account-Koordinator und als Außendienstmitarbeiter für mehrere Konten fungieren. Sie arbeiten mit Underwriting-Partnern zusammen, um die Risikoqualität des Zürich-Asset-Portfolios zu verwalten, Kundenrisikokontrollprogramme zu unterstützen, vor Ort Risikobewertungen durchzuführen, Kontoanalysen zu entwickeln und Folgesitzungen zu koordinieren, wobei Sie die globalen technischen Standards und anerkannten Codes von Zurich einhalten.

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Erfahrung für die Zukunft in einem unterstützenden Umfeld zu entwickeln, in dem Ihre Stimme zählt. Der Zweck dieses Postings ist es, eine bereits vakante Position zu besetzen.

Zurich Canada nutzt Technologietools der künstlichen Intelligenz, um bestimmte Aspekte des Rekrutierungsprozesses zu unterstützen, einschließlich der Erstprüfung und des Screenings von Bewerbungen. Künstliche Intelligenz ist nicht die einzige Grundlage für das Screening oder die Auswahl von Kandidaten. Alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden von qualifizierten Rekrutierungsexperten überprüft und getroffen.

Zurich wendet ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell an, das an drei Tagen in der Woche eine persönliche Anwesenheit erfordert.

Was Sie tun werden

• Beurteilen Sie die Qualität komplexer Risiken und konzentrieren Sie sich auf wichtige und strategische Assets, wie sie in den Zurich Resilience Solutions Standards definiert sind.
• Bewerten Sie potenzielle Verluste nach Zürich und Branchendefinitionen.
• Unterstützung externer Kunden durch die Identifizierung, Bewertung und Reduzierung von Risiken im Zusammenhang mit ihren wichtigsten/strategischen Vermögenswerten und ihren Gesamtkonten.
• Bereitstellung geeigneter Empfehlungen zur Risikoverbesserung, Durchführung von Verlustuntersuchungen (einschließlich Trend- und Ursachenanalyse) und Implementierung von Risikoverbesserungsprogrammen.
• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv mit Risikoingenieuren in diesem Bereich; pflegen Sie Beziehungen zu Zeichnungspartnern, Maklern, Branchenberatern, Berufsverbänden und Lizenzbehörden.
• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Kundendienstpläne für koordinierte Konten, um die Effektivität von Außendiensten zu unterstützen.
• Gewährleistung der Konsistenz und Qualität der für das Konto bereitgestellten Dienste, einschließlich Bewertungen, Empfehlungen zur Risikoverbesserung, Berichterstattung sowie Zeit- und Ausgabenmanagement.
• Entdecken Sie neue Servicemöglichkeiten, entwickeln Sie neue Services für Kunden und identifizieren Sie Cross-Sales-Potenziale.
• Unterstützen Sie das Geschäftswachstum von Zurich Resilience Solutions, indem Sie erstklassige Beratungs- und Vertriebsdienstleistungen anbieten, Chancen identifizieren und starke Kundenbeziehungen pflegen.
• Verwalten Sie Änderungen innerhalb von Konten durch engen Kontakt mit Kundenmanagementteams und Geschäftspartnern, einschließlich der Überprüfung neuer Projekte und Änderungspläne.

Positionsqualifikationen - Was Sie mitbringen

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor-Abschluss und mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Property Risk Engineering
ODER
• High-School-Diplom oder gleichwertig und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Property Risk Engineering
ODER
• Zurich Certified Apprenticeship Program, inklusive Hochschulabschluss und mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Property Risk Engineering
UND
• Erfahrung mit Microsoft Office
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über Risiken und Kontrollen im Industriesektor
• Arbeitserfahrung im Team

Vermögenswerte:
• Bachelor of Engineering, Bauingenieurwesen oder verwandte Disziplin
• Bezeichnung des Risikomanagements (RMC)
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Konten als Risikomanagement-Dienstleistungsberater für mittelständische Unternehmen oder Großkunden in der Versicherung von verwandten Gütern und Programmen
• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und starke ergebnisorientierte Beratungsfähigkeiten
• Hervorragende Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten
• Beherrschung von gesprochenem und geschriebenem Französisch
• Beherrschung von gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch erforderlich, um die Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern außerhalb von Quebec zu erleichtern.

Unsere Kultur

• Bei Zürich sind wir stolz auf unsere Kultur. Wir sind begeistert von Vielfalt, Inklusion, Fairness und Zugehörigkeitsgefühl (DIEB). Wir möchten, dass Sie selbst bei der Arbeit sind und unsere Mitarbeiter die Gemeinschaften widerspiegeln, in denen wir leben und arbeiten. Unsere DIEB-Initiativen zielen darauf ab, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich jeder willkommen fühlt.
• Wir pflegen eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, in der die Vielfalt des Denkens geschätzt wird. Wir schätzen Ihre Ideen und bemühen uns, unseren Mitarbeitern die Werkzeuge zu geben, die sie brauchen, um etwas zu bewirken.
• Wir kümmern uns um das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter und bieten einen umfassenden Leistungs- und Gesundheitsplan mit unterschiedlichen, auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittenen Deckungsniveaus sowie ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gesamtvergütungsprogramm.
• Wir verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, sich auszuruhen, Batterien aufzuladen und das zu tun, was wir lieben. In Zürich profitieren alle Mitarbeiter dafür von mindestens vier Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr.
• Wir verstehen auch, dass Mitarbeiter manchmal aus persönlichen Gründen Urlaub benötigen. Sie können einen Termin während eines Arbeitstages, eine kulturelle oder religiöse Feier haben, um hervorzuheben oder einfach Zeit brauchen, um sich auf Ihre psychische Gesundheit zu konzentrieren. Zürich Mitarbeiter haben vier persönliche Tage pro Jahr nach eigenem Ermessen zu nutzen.
• Wir verpflichten uns zu kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und bieten Zugang zu einer Vielzahl von Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
• Wir kümmern uns um unsere Gemeinschaften. Unsere Gemeinden sind die Orte, an denen unsere Kunden, Mitarbeiter und Aktionäre leben und arbeiten. Obwohl wir stolz auf den Beitrag von Zurich für die Gesellschaft durch seine Kernversicherungstätigkeit sein können, müssen wir auch durch unser Talent, unsere Zeit und unsere Ressourcen unseren Gemeinden etwas zurückgeben.
• Wir haben viele Auszeichnungen für unsere Arbeitskultur gewonnen. Wir sind stolz darauf, einer der Top-Arbeitgeber im Großraum Toronto zu sein und den 5-Sterne Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award von Insurance Business Canada erhalten zu haben.

Machen Sie einen Unterschied. Heben Sie Herausforderungen auf. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Unterstützt werden. Liebe, was du tust. Arbeiten Sie mit uns.

Über uns

Zurich Canada ist Teil der Zurich Insurance Group, einem Branchenversicherer mit rund 55.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit, der Kunden in globalen und lokalen Märkten betreut. Zurich Canada ist ein großer Versicherungsanbieter, der seit 100 Jahren mittelständische und große Unternehmen, darunter multinationale, auf dem kanadischen Geschäftsversicherungsmarkt betreut. Mit mehr als 650 Mitarbeitern in Büros im ganzen Land bietet Zürich die globale Stärke eines großen Versicherers, kombiniert mit einer gründlichen Kenntnis der lokalen Geschäftsbereiche und Märkte. Zurich Canada strebt danach, die erste Wahl für Risikomanagement-Profis als Referenzpartner zu sein, um sie bei der Bewältigung der Risikoherausforderungen von heute und morgen zu unterstützen. Für weitere Informationen besuchen Sie www.zurichcanada.com .

Eine Zukunft mit Zürich

Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, voranzukommen und einen Unterschied zu machen. Bei Zurich möchten wir, dass Sie Ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Ideen teilen, damit wir gemeinsam wachsen und nachhaltige Veränderungen vorantreiben können. Als Teil einer führenden globalen Organisation verfügt Zurich North America über mehr als 148 Jahre Erfahrung im Management von Risiken und der Unterstützung von Resilienz. Wir sind ein führender Anbieter von gewerblichen Unfallversicherungslösungen und einer breiten Palette von Risikomanagementprodukten und -dienstleistungen für Unternehmen und Einzelpersonen. Heute bedienen wir mehr als 25 Branchen, von der Landwirtschaft bis zur Technologie und versichern 90% der Fortune 500®. Unsere Wachstumsstrategie beschränkt sich nicht auf unser Geschäft. Als Arbeitgeber bietet Zurich Möglichkeiten zur kontinuierlichen Karriereentwicklung und fördert ein Umfeld, in dem Stimmen vielfältig sind, Verhaltensweisen inklusiv sind, Handlungen Gerechtigkeit fördern und unsere Mitarbeiter sich zugehörig fühlen. Seien Sie Teil der nächsten Entwicklung der Versicherungsbranche. Begleiten Sie uns beim Aufbau einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeiter, unsere Kunden und die Gemeinschaften, denen wir dienen.

Als globales Unternehmen erkennt Zurich die Vielfalt unserer Belegschaft als Aktivposten an. Wir begrüßen talentierte Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen mit einzigartigen Perspektiven, die hier wirklich willkommen sind. Zusammengenommen bringen uns Diversität und Inklusion unserem gemeinsamen Ziel näher: exeeding our customers Zurich setzt sich dafür ein, ein vielfältiges, integratives und barrierefreies Umfeld zu schaffen, das zu einer barrierefreien Organisation für Mitarbeiter, Kunden und andere Parteien führt, die mit Zurich interagieren oder diese benötigen. Wir streiken gegen einen Arbeitnehmer, der frei von Diskriminierung jeglicher Art ist, einschließlich Diskriminierung aufgrund einer körperlichen oder geistigen Behinderung oder eines medizinischen Zustands. Wenn Sie an einer Jobmöglichkeit interessiert sind, informieren Sie bitte, wenn Sie eine Unterkunft benötigen, damit wir mit Ihnen zusammenarbeiten können, um einen zugänglicheren Prozess bereitzustellen.

Zurich akzeptiert keine unaufgeforderten Ergebnisse von Suchfirmen oder Arbeitsagenturen. Jede unaufgeforderte Zusammenfassung wird Eigentum der Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. jobs.description:
Zurich North America’s Staff Legal Office is currently hiring a Paralegal II, General Liability to join their team! Under the supervision of an attorney, the successful candidate’s work will be in support of moderate to complex liability litigation cases (e.g. case work, research, discovery responses, subpoenas, etc.).

At Zurich North America we acknowledge that work life-balance is a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable, our hybrid model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, requiring in-office attendance only once a week at our Irvine office.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Drafting legal pleadings, correspondence, and other documents as directed

- Providing legal support such as legal and documentary research

- Monitoring and adhering to case schedules and filing deadlines

- Conducting interviews, summarizing depositions, reviewing discovery responses and medical records

- Preparing discovery requests and responses

- Subpoenaing, collecting and organizing records from non-parties

- Scheduling Surveillance, Compulsory Medical Exams, and Site Inspections

- Assisting in trial preparation

- Responding to inquiries from and interacting with customers, clients, counsel, and witnesses

- Organizing and maintaining case files and documentation, electronically

- Contributing to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed

- Collaborating with attorneys, staff, claims professionals and leadership to accomplish successful business and litigation outcomes.

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the Legal Support area

OR

- Associate Degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Legal Support area

AND

- Experience conducting electronic database research

- Experience drafting legal documents, correspondence, and/or pleadings

- Experience in legal support

- Experience with Microsoft Office

Additional requirement for California only:
Paralegals must meet one of the following requirements:

- Have a paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program
OR

- Have a certificate from an accredited paralegal program with at least 24 semester units of law-related courses
OR

- Have a bachelor's degree or higher and one year of law-related experience under the supervision of a California-licensed attorney who has been practicing for the past three years (or an attorney who's practiced in California federal courts for the past three years).

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree or Paralegal Certificate

- Defense experience

- Insurance industry experience

- Ability to effectively conduct electronic database research, including Lexus Nexis

- Comfortable working in a paperless work environment

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to effectively draft legal documents, correspondence, and/or pleadings

- Strong Microsoft Office and technical skills

- Familiarity with litigation management software systems

- Trial experience, including preparing trial exhibits and witnesses

- Experiencing filing with the California Courts E-filing system.

- Familiarity with California Rules of Civil Procedure and local Rules

- Experience navigating Clerk, Court and Judicial websites

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $38.00 - $45.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 5%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Remote Working: Hybrid
Schedule: Full Time
Employment Sponsorship Offered: No

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lo Staff Legal Office di Zurigo Nord America sta attualmente assumendo un Paralegal II, General Liability per unirsi alla loro squadra! A Zurigo Nord America riconosciamo che l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una priorità quando si tratta di scegliere la tua prossima mossa di carriera. jobs.description:
The Opportunity:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who is passionate about building reliable systems, automating infrastructure, and enabling fast, high quality software delivery. You will be part of a high impact team responsible for designing cloud infrastructure, improving developer workflows, and shaping our DevOps and automation strategy.

Key Responsibilities

- AWS & IaC: Design and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS using Terraform to drive full lifecycle automation.

- Containerization: Design, maintain, and support scalable containerized workloads using ECS or similar container platforms. Assist with service auto scaling policies to ensure high availability.

- CI/CD: Build, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools. Automate build, provisioning, and deployment workflows using Python and/or Bash.

- DevSecOps: Integrate and maintain automated security checks within CI/CD pipelines. Support the use of security and vulnerability scanning tools such as SonarQube, Veracode, and Prisma Cloud.

- Observability: Monitor system performance and reliability using Dynatrace or similar APM tools. Participate in troubleshooting and incident response activities.

Qualifications:

- 4+ years of professional experience in DevOps or SRE roles.

- Hands on experience with one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Practical experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code or a similar IaC tool.

- Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (eg. GitHub, GitLab).

- Familiarity with system monitoring, APM, and proactive alerting.

- Proficient in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or Go).

- Excellent troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Willingness to learn, collaborate, and improve existing systems.

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- DevSecOps: Integrieren und pflegen Sie automatisierte Sicherheitsüberprüfungen in CI/CD-Pipelines. Unterstützen Sie die Verwendung von Sicherheits- und Schwachstellen-Scan-Tools wie SonarQube, Veracode und Prisma Cloud.

- Observability: Überwachen Sie die Systemleistung und -zuverlässigkeit mit Dynatrace oder ähnlichen APM-Tools. Beteiligen Sie sich an Aktivitäten zur Fehlerbehebung und Incident Response.

Qualifikationen:

- 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in DevOps oder SRE Rollen.

- Erfahrungen mit einem großen Cloud-Anbieter (AWS, Azure oder GCP).

- Praktische Erfahrung mit Terraform for Infrastructure as Code oder einem ähnlichen IaC-Tool.

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit CI/CD-Pipelines (z.B. GitHub, GitLab).

- Vertrautheit mit Systemüberwachung, APM und proaktiver Alarmierung.

- Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Skriptsprache (Python, Bash oder Go).

- Hervorragende Fähigkeiten zur Fehlersuche, Analyse und Problemlösung.

- Bereitschaft zu lernen, zusammenzuarbeiten und bestehende Systeme zu verbessern.

Du bist das Herz und die Seele von Zürich!

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Wir legen großen Wert auf die Erfahrung und das Know-how unserer Mitarbeiter und bieten eine breite Palette von Möglichkeiten in allen Geschäftsbereichen, um Sie zu ermutigen, sich für neue Möglichkeiten innerhalb von Zürich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit für Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt sind.

Lasst uns gemeinsam weiter wachsen!

jobs.title: High-Net-Worth Underwriter
jobs.description:
Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis.

Location: Manchester or Chipping Norton, Hybrid

Salary: £34,000 to £42,000 depending on experience plus excellent benefits and career development opportunities.

The opportunity:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Trading Underwriter to join our High Net Worth team, specialising in home and motor products. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in underwriting, excellent market awareness, and a keen ability to build and maintain relationships with brokers and clients.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

Key responsibilities:

- Evaluate and underwrite high-value home and motor insurance policies for high-net-worth clients, adhering to underwriting guidelines and risk appetites.

- Develop and sustain robust relationships with brokers, clients, and other key stakeholders to drive business growth and enhance client satisfaction.

- Analyse and assess risk exposures to provide bespoke insurance solutions tailored to the unique needs of high-net-worth clients.

- Monitor and manage the profitability of the portfolio, ensuring that underwriting decisions align with the company's financial objectives.

- Collaborate with internal teams, including claims, actuarial, and risk management, to ensure a holistic approach to underwriting and client service.

- Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes to inform underwriting strategies and maintain a competitive advantage.

- Participate in client and broker meetings, presentations, and other marketing activities to promote Zurich's high net worth home and motor insurance products.

Your skills and experience:

- Underwriting experience within the high-net-worth sector, specifically in home and motor products.

- Strong analytical and decision-making skills with a proven ability to assess complex risks.

- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with brokers and clients.

- Proficient in using underwriting software and tools.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday, alongside a range of other flexible benefits.

You can find out more about our wide range of employee benefits on our website .

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 65,000 employees, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company that is a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee: to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you’re interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment where your creativity, ideas and contributions are recognised and rewarded, Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our culture:

At Zurich, our strength comes from the diverse experiences, perspectives and talents of our people. Our goal is to create a workplace where every employee can flourish and where everyone feels valued, heard and respected.

Over a quarter of our employees are members of at least one of our inclusion communities (Employee Resource Groups), with groups focused on areas such as social mobility and cultural awareness. We’re proud to have received numerous industry awards recognising our diversity and inclusion policies and initiatives.

We’ve created an environment that places real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide practical advice and access to a wide range of lifestyle support, alongside opportunities to learn, grow and develop the skills needed for the future.

We actively support our employees to give back to their communities through volunteering and charitable activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest‑established corporate trusts in the UK. Together, we’ve supported causes across the UK through grants and volunteering, contributing over £100 million in funding and volunteered time.

Your application:

We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.

As an inclusive employer we also want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com

So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

The financials

- Life cover - four times your salary.

Time away

- 28 days holiday a year plus bank holidays.

- You can also request to swap UK bank holidays for days off that have cultural or religious significance to you.

- The option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

- Three days paid volunteering.

- Up to 16 weeks' full pay for maternity, paternity and adoption leave.

Your health is important to us

- Access to Private medical insurance.

- Virtual GP appointments.

- Discounted gym membership.

- Free flu jab.

- Access to a wealth of support from our wellbeing partners.

We're making a difference

- Creating a brighter, more sustainable future underpins all that we do here in Zurich. We were the first insurer to sign the ‘UN Business Ambition for 1.5˚C’ pledge.

- Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, has awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ore lavorative: Questo ruolo è disponibile a tempo parziale, a tempo pieno o a tempo pieno.

Ubicazione: Manchester o Chipping Norton, Hybrid

Salario: £ 34,000 a £ 42,000 a seconda dell'esperienza più eccellenti benefici e opportunità di sviluppo della carriera.

L'opportunità:
Stiamo cercando un Trading Underwriter esperto e motivato per unirsi al nostro team High Net Worth, specializzato in prodotti casalinghi e motori. Il candidato ideale avrà un forte background nel sottoscrivere, la consapevolezza del mercato eccellente, e una forte capacità di costruire e mantenere relazioni con i broker e i clienti.

Molti dei nostri dipendenti lavorano in modo flessibile in una varietà di modi diversi, tra cui ore part-time, orari flessibili, quote di lavoro, un elemento di lavoro da casa o ore compresse. Questo perché vogliamo le persone migliori per i nostri ruoli, e riconosciamo che a volte quelle persone non sono disponibili a tempo pieno. Si prega di parlare con noi durante l'intervista sulla flessibilità che potrebbe essere necessario.

Responsabilità chiave:

- Valutare e sottoscrivere le politiche di assicurazione casa e motore ad alto valore per i clienti ad alto valore di rete, aderendo a sottoscrivere linee guida e appetito di rischio.

- Sviluppare e sostenere relazioni robuste con broker, clienti e altri stakeholder chiave per guidare la crescita aziendale e migliorare la soddisfazione del cliente.

- Analizzare e valutare le esposizioni di rischio per fornire soluzioni di assicurazione su misura per le esigenze uniche dei clienti ad alto valore di rete.

- Monitorare e gestire la redditività del portafoglio, assicurando che le decisioni di sottoscrizione si allineino agli obiettivi finanziari dell'azienda.

- Collaborare con i team interni, inclusi i reclami, l'attualizzazione e la gestione dei rischi, per garantire un approccio olistico alla sottoscrizione e al servizio clienti.

- Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze del mercato, sulle attività concorrenti e sui cambiamenti normativi per informare le strategie di sottoscrizione e mantenere un vantaggio competitivo.

- Partecipa a incontri, presentazioni e altre attività di marketing per promuovere l'alta rete di prodotti di assicurazione casa e motore di Zurigo.

Le tue competenze e la tua esperienza:

- Esperienza di scrittura all'interno del settore high-net-worth, in particolare nei prodotti casalinghi e motori.

- Forte capacità analitiche e decisionali con una comprovata capacità di valutare i rischi complessi.

- Competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione eccezionali, con la capacità di costruire e mantenere relazioni efficaci con i broker e i clienti.

- Proficiente nell'utilizzo di software e strumenti di sottoscrizione.

- Dimostrata capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team collaborativo.

- Forte capacità organizzativa con la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente frenetico.

Cosa otterrai in cambio?

Ognuno è diverso. Ecco perché a Zurigo offriamo una vasta gamma di vantaggi per i nostri dipendenti in modo che i nostri clienti possano scegliere ciò che si adatta a loro e alla loro vita. I nostri vantaggi offrono una reale flessibilità in modo che le nostre persone possano fare scelte considerate e personalizzare i loro benefici durante tutto l'anno. I nostri benefici includono il 12% di pensione non contributiva definita, il bonus annuale dell'azienda, l'assicurazione medica privata e la possibilità di acquistare fino a un ulteriore 20 giorni o vendere alcuni della vostra vacanza, insieme a una serie di altri benefici flessibili.

Potete scoprire di più sulla nostra vasta gamma di benefici per i dipendenti sul nostro sito web .

Chi siamo:

A Zurigo aspiriamo ad essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d'impatto del mondo. Insieme, stiamo creando un futuro più luminoso per i nostri clienti, la nostra gente e il nostro pianeta.

Con oltre 65.000 dipendenti, sentirete il supporto di essere parte di una società forte e stabile che è un giocatore di lunga data nel settore assicurativo.

Abbiamo fatto una promessa l’uno all’altro e ogni dipendente: concentrarsi sull’impatto sostenibile, prendersi cura del benessere dell’altro, utilizzare le nostre diverse competenze per essere curiosi e ottimisti e sviluppare le competenze necessarie per il nostro futuro.

Se siete interessati a lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante dove la vostra creatività, idee e contributi sono riconosciuti e premiati, Zurigo potrebbe essere il posto giusto per voi. Fai parte di qualcosa di grande.

La nostra cultura:

A Zurigo, la nostra forza proviene dalle diverse esperienze, prospettive e talenti del nostro popolo. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di creare un posto di lavoro dove ogni dipendente può fiorire e dove tutti si sentono valorizzati, ascoltati e rispettati.

Oltre un quarto dei nostri dipendenti sono membri di almeno una delle nostre comunità di inclusione (Employee Resource Groups), con gruppi focalizzati su aree come la mobilità sociale e la consapevolezza culturale. Siamo orgogliosi di aver ricevuto numerosi premi nel settore riconoscendo le nostre politiche e iniziative di inclusione e diversità.

Abbiamo creato un ambiente che pone la reale importanza sul benessere della nostra gente da una prospettiva fisica, mentale, sociale e finanziaria. Lavoriamo con i nostri partner di benessere e gli esperti del settore per fornire consigli pratici e l'accesso a una vasta gamma di supporto allo stile di vita, insieme alle opportunità per imparare, crescere e sviluppare le competenze necessarie per il futuro.

Sosteniamo attivamente i nostri dipendenti per restituire alle loro comunità attraverso attività di volontariato e di beneficenza. Il nostro braccio caritativo, Zurich Community Trust, è uno dei più consolidati trust aziendali nel Regno Unito. Insieme, abbiamo sostenuto le cause in tutto il Regno Unito attraverso sovvenzioni e volontariato, contribuendo oltre 100 milioni di sterline nel finanziamento e nel tempo offerto.

La tua domanda:

Ci impegniamo a trattare tutti i candidati in modo equo e rispettoso, indipendentemente dal loro sfondo reale o assunto, orientamento sessuale, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta.

Come datore di lavoro inclusivo vogliamo anche garantire che tutti i candidati si sentano a proprio agio e sono in grado di eseguire al meglio durante l'intervista. Avrete la possibilità di farci sapere qualsiasi ragionevole adattamento o supporto pratico necessario quando si applica.

Ci piacerebbe se si poteva presentare la vostra applicazione online. Se avete bisogno di un metodo alternativo di applicazione, si prega di inviare una email a recruit@uk.zurich.com

Quindi, fai la differenza. Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Sii supportato. Adoro quello che fai. Lavora per noi.

- Il nostro braccio caritativo, Zurich Community Trust, ha concesso borse di studio e tempo di volontariato per meritare cause nel Regno Unito valutate a oltre 90 milioni di sterline.

Bitte sprechen Sie mit uns im Interview über die Flexibilität, die Sie möglicherweise benötigen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

- Bewerten und zeichnen Sie hochwertige Haus- und Kfz-Versicherungspolicen für vermögende Kunden unter Einhaltung von Zeichnungsrichtlinien und Risikobereitschaft.

- Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung robuster Beziehungen zu Brokern, Kunden und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern, um das Geschäftswachstum zu fördern und die Kundenzufriedenheit zu verbessern.

- Analysieren und bewerten Sie die Risiken, um maßgeschneiderte Versicherungslösungen zu bieten, die auf die einzigartigen Bedürfnisse von vermögenden Kunden zugeschnitten sind.

- Überwachung und Verwaltung der Rentabilität des Portfolios, um sicherzustellen, dass Zeichnungsentscheidungen mit den finanziellen Zielen des Unternehmens übereinstimmen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams, einschließlich Schaden-, Versicherungs- und Risikomanagement, um einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz für das Underwriting und den Kundenservice zu gewährleisten.

- Bleiben Sie über Markttrends, Wettbewerberaktivitäten und regulatorische Änderungen auf dem Laufenden, um Zeichnungsstrategien zu informieren und einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu wahren.

- Nehmen Sie an Kunden- und Broker-Meetings, Präsentationen und anderen Marketingaktivitäten teil, um Zürichs vermögende Haus- und Kfz-Versicherungsprodukte zu bewerben.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen:

- Underwriting-Erfahrung im vermögenden Sektor, insbesondere bei Heim- und Motorprodukten.

- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Entscheidungsfindung mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, komplexe Risiken zu bewerten.

- Außergewöhnliche zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektive Beziehungen zu Brokern und Kunden aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten.

- Proficient in der Verwendung von Underwriting-Software und Tools.

- Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines kollaborativen Teams zu arbeiten.

- Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten.

Was bekommen Sie im Gegenzug?

Jeder ist anders. Deshalb bieten wir in Zürich ein breites Spektrum an Mitarbeiterleistungen, damit unsere Mitarbeiter wählen können, was zu ihnen und ihrem Leben passt. Unsere Vorteile bieten echte Flexibilität, damit unsere Mitarbeiter überlegte Entscheidungen treffen und ihre Vorteile das ganze Jahr über anpassen können. Unsere Leistungen umfassen eine beitragsunabhängige Altersversorgung von 12%, einen jährlichen Unternehmensbonus, eine private Krankenversicherung und die Option, bis zu 20 zusätzliche Tage zu kaufen oder einen Teil Ihres Urlaubs zu verkaufen, sowie eine Reihe anderer flexibler Leistungen.

Sie können mehr über unsere breite Palette von Arbeitnehmerleistungen auf unserer Website erfahren.

Wer wir sind:

Bei Zurich streben wir danach, eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt zu sein. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten.

Mit über 65.000 Mitarbeitern werden Sie die Unterstützung spüren, Teil eines starken und stabilen Unternehmens zu sein, das ein langjähriger Akteur in der Versicherungsbranche ist.

Wir haben uns gegenseitig und jedem Mitarbeiter ein Versprechen gegeben: sich auf nachhaltige Auswirkungen zu konzentrieren, uns um das Wohlergehen des anderen zu kümmern, unser vielfältiges Fachwissen zu nutzen, um neugierig und optimistisch zu sein und die Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die für unsere Zukunft erforderlich sind.

Wenn Sie daran interessiert sind, in einem dynamischen und herausfordernden Umfeld zu arbeiten, in dem Ihre Kreativität, Ideen und Beiträge anerkannt und belohnt werden, ist Zürich genau der richtige Ort für Sie. Sei Teil von etwas Großem.

Unsere Kultur:

Bei Zurich kommt unsere Stärke aus den vielfältigen Erfahrungen, Perspektiven und Talenten unserer Mitarbeiter. Unser Ziel ist es, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem jeder Mitarbeiter gedeihen kann und an dem sich jeder geschätzt, gehört und respektiert fühlt.

Über ein Viertel unserer Mitarbeiter sind Mitglieder von mindestens einer unserer Inklusionsgemeinschaften (Mitarbeiterressourcengruppen), wobei sich Gruppen auf Bereiche wie soziale Mobilität und kulturelles Bewusstsein konzentrieren. Wir sind stolz darauf, zahlreiche Branchenauszeichnungen erhalten zu haben, die unsere Diversitäts- und Inklusionsrichtlinien und -initiativen würdigen.

Wir haben ein Umfeld geschaffen, in dem das Wohlbefinden unserer Menschen aus physischer, mentaler, sozialer und finanzieller Sicht einen echten Stellenwert hat. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Wohlfühlpartnern und Branchenexperten zusammen, um praktische Beratung und Zugang zu einer breiten Palette von Lifestyle-Unterstützung zu bieten, neben Möglichkeiten zu lernen, zu wachsen und die für die Zukunft erforderlichen Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln.

Wir unterstützen unsere Mitarbeiter aktiv dabei, ihren Gemeinschaften durch Freiwilligenarbeit und gemeinnützige Aktivitäten etwas zurückzugeben. Unser gemeinnütziger Arm, der Zurich Community Trust, ist einer der am längsten etablierten Corporate Trusts in Großbritannien. Gemeinsam haben wir Anliegen in ganz Großbritannien durch Zuschüsse und Freiwilligenarbeit unterstützt und über 100 Millionen Pfund an Finanzierung und freiwilliger Zeit beigetragen.

Ihr Antrag:

Wir verpflichten uns, alle Bewerber fair und mit Respekt zu behandeln, unabhängig von ihrem tatsächlichen oder angenommenen Hintergrund, ihrer sexuellen Orientierung, Behinderung oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen.

Als inklusiver Arbeitgeber wollen wir auch sicherstellen, dass sich alle Kandidaten wohl fühlen und während des Interviews ihre besten Leistungen erbringen können. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, uns jede angemessene Anpassung oder praktische Unterstützung mitzuteilen, die bei Ihrer Bewerbung erforderlich ist.

Wir würden es lieben, wenn sie ihre bewerbung online einreichen könnten. Wenn Sie eine alternative Bewerbungsmethode benötigen, senden Sie bitte eine E-Mail an recruiting@uk.zurich.com

Also, machen Sie einen Unterschied. Werden Sie herausgefordert. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Unterstützt werden. Liebe, was du tust. Arbeitet für uns.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Heures de travail: Ce rôle est disponible à temps partiel, en partage d'emploi ou à temps plein.

Lieu: Manchester ou Chipping Norton, Hybride

Salaire : 34 000 à 42 000 livres, selon l'expérience et les avantages et possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel.

L'occasion :
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Sous-rédacteur Trading compétent et motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe High Net Worth, spécialisée dans les produits à domicile et à moteur. Le candidat idéal aura une solide expérience dans la souscription, une excellente sensibilisation au marché, et une grande capacité à établir et maintenir des relations avec les courtiers et les clients.

Beaucoup de nos employés travaillent avec souplesse de diverses façons, y compris à temps partiel, des heures flexibles, des parts de travail, un élément de travail à domicile ou des heures comprimées. C'est parce que nous voulons les meilleures personnes pour nos rôles, et nous reconnaissons que parfois ces personnes ne sont pas disponibles à temps plein. Veuillez nous parler à l'entrevue de la flexibilité dont vous pourriez avoir besoin.

Principales responsabilités :

- Évaluer et souscrire des polices d'assurance habitation et automobile de grande valeur pour les clients à haute valeur nette, en respectant les lignes directrices de souscription et les appétits en matière de risques.

- Établir et entretenir des relations solides avec les courtiers, les clients et d'autres intervenants clés pour stimuler la croissance des entreprises et améliorer la satisfaction de la clientèle.

- Analyser et évaluer les expositions au risque afin de fournir des solutions d'assurance sur mesure adaptées aux besoins uniques des clients à forte valeur nette.

- Surveiller et gérer la rentabilité du portefeuille, en veillant à ce que les décisions de souscription correspondent aux objectifs financiers de l'entreprise.

- Collaborer avec les équipes internes, y compris les demandes de remboursement, la gestion actuarielle et la gestion des risques, pour assurer une approche globale de la souscription et du service à la clientèle.

- Restez au courant des tendances du marché, des activités des concurrents et des changements réglementaires afin d'informer les stratégies de souscription et de maintenir un avantage concurrentiel.

- Participez à des réunions de clients et de courtiers, à des présentations et à d'autres activités de marketing pour promouvoir les produits d'assurance habitation et automobile de grande valeur de Zurich.

Vos compétences et votre expérience :

- Expérience de souscription dans le secteur à haute valeur nette, en particulier dans les produits à domicile et à moteur.

- De solides compétences en analyse et en prise de décision, avec une capacité éprouvée d'évaluer les risques complexes.

- Compétences interpersonnelles et de communication exceptionnelles, avec la capacité d'établir et de maintenir des relations efficaces avec les courtiers et les clients.

- Compétence dans l'utilisation des logiciels et des outils de souscription.

- Capacité démontrée de travailler de façon indépendante et dans le cadre d'une équipe collaborative.

- Des compétences organisationnelles solides avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement rapide.

Qu'obtiendras-tu en retour ?

Tout le monde est différent. C'est pourquoi à Zurich, nous offrons un large éventail d'avantages sociaux afin que nos gens puissent choisir ce qui leur convient et leur vie. Nos avantages offrent une réelle flexibilité afin que nos employés puissent faire des choix réfléchis et adapter leurs avantages tout au long de l'année. Nos prestations comprennent un régime de retraite non contributif défini de 12%, une prime annuelle d'entreprise, une assurance médicale privée et l'option d'acheter jusqu'à 20 jours supplémentaires ou de vendre une partie de vos vacances, ainsi qu'une gamme d'autres prestations flexibles.

Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur notre large gamme d'avantages sociaux sur notre site .

Qui nous sommes :

À Zurich, nous souhaitons être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes au monde. Ensemble, nous créons un avenir meilleur pour nos clients, nos gens et notre planète.

Avec plus de 65 000 employés, vous aurez l'impression de faire partie d'une entreprise forte et stable qui est un acteur de longue date dans le secteur de l'assurance.

Nous avons fait une promesse entre nous et chaque employé : nous concentrer sur l'impact durable, nous soucier de notre bien-être, utiliser notre expertise diversifiée pour être curieux et optimiste et développer les compétences nécessaires à notre avenir.

Si vous êtes intéressé à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où votre créativité, vos idées et vos contributions sont reconnues et récompensées, Zurich pourrait être l'endroit idéal pour vous. Faites partie de quelque chose de génial.

Notre culture :

À Zurich, notre force vient des diverses expériences, perspectives et talents de notre peuple. Notre objectif est de créer un milieu de travail où chaque employé peut prospérer et où chacun se sent valorisé, entendu et respecté.

Plus d'un quart de nos employés sont membres d'au moins une de nos communautés d'inclusion (groupes de ressources pour les employés), et les groupes sont axés sur des domaines comme la mobilité sociale et la sensibilisation culturelle. Nous sommes fiers d'avoir reçu de nombreux prix de l'industrie reconnaissant notre diversité et nos politiques et initiatives d'inclusion.

Nous avons créé un environnement qui accorde une réelle importance au bien-être de notre population d'un point de vue physique, mental, social et financier. Nous travaillons avec nos partenaires de bien-être et des experts de l'industrie pour fournir des conseils pratiques et un accès à un large éventail de soutien au mode de vie, ainsi que des occasions d'apprendre, de grandir et de développer les compétences nécessaires pour l'avenir.

Nous soutenons activement nos employés pour qu'ils rendent à leurs collectivités par le bénévolat et les activités de bienfaisance. Notre bras charitable, Zurich Community Trust, est l'une des sociétés de fiducie les plus anciennes au Royaume-Uni. Ensemble, nous avons soutenu des causes dans tout le Royaume-Uni par des subventions et du bénévolat, contribuant à plus de 100 millions de livres en financement et en temps bénévole.

Votre demande :

Nous nous engageons à traiter tous les candidats avec équité et respect, indépendamment de leur origine réelle ou supposée, de leur orientation sexuelle, de leur handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée.

En tant qu'employeur inclusif, nous voulons également nous assurer que tous les candidats et candidates se sentent à l'aise et qu'ils sont en mesure de s'acquitter au mieux de leurs fonctions pendant l'entrevue. Vous aurez l'occasion de nous faire part de tout ajustement raisonnable ou soutien pratique nécessaire lorsque vous postulerez.

Nous aimerions que vous soumettiez votre candidature en ligne. Si vous avez besoin d'une autre méthode de candidature, veuillez envoyer un courriel à recrutement@uk.zurich.com

Alors, faites une différence. Soyez défiés. Soyez inspiré. Soyez soutenu. J'adore ce que tu fais. Travaille pour nous.

Les finances

Temps écoulé

- 28 jours de vacances par an plus jours fériés.

- Trois jours de bénévolat payé.

- Jusqu'à 16 semaines de salaire complet pour les congés de maternité, de paternité et d'adoption.

Votre santé est importante pour nous

- Accès à l'assurance médicale privée.

- Des rendez-vous virtuels.

- Membre de salle de sport à rabais.

- Grippe libre.

- L'accès à une mine de soutien de nos partenaires bien-être.

Nous faisons une différence

- Créer un avenir plus radieux et plus durable sous-tend tout ce que nous faisons ici à Zurich. Nous avons été le premier assureur à signer l'engagement « UN Business Ambition » pour 1,5 C.

- Notre bras charitable, Zurich Community Trust, a accordé des subventions et du temps bénévole à des causes méritantes au Royaume-Uni d'une valeur de plus de 90 millions de livres.

jobs.title: UA Associate - Construction Property
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is currently hiring a UA Associate or UA Analyst – Construction Property to join the Construction Property team in our Denver office!

At Zurich North America we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected.

This is a hybrid work position, however, the candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report into one of the following North American office locations: Denver, CO

As a UA Associate or UA Analyst – Construction Property, you will support and work closely with experienced Underwriters in the review and analysis of risks. You will enjoy the opportunity to fully apply and hone your research and analytical skills to effectively assess risk and grow your career.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Reviews, evaluates, and summarizes risk exposures, controls, loss history, and financial condition to aid underwriting decisions around submission acceptance or declination.

- Follows instructions from Underwriters in areas of policy rating, subjective pricing, policy construction, coverages & exclusions, mandatory forms, etc. to accurately quote and issue policies.

- Provides account servicing support in collaboration with Underwriter and Manager, with responsibility for end-to-end servicing processes for new business, renewals, and endorsements for basic to moderately complex business and products.

- Responds to written, verbal telephone inquiries appropriately and on time under close supervision by Underwriter and/or Manager. Working collaboratively with assigned underwriters.

- Supports Underwriter with broker/agent/distributor/customer interactions by providing basic customer service skills.

The role will be filled at the UA Associate or UA Analyst level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

UA Associate – Construction Property Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and no prior experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associate Degree and no prior experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
AND

- Knowledge of data collection and analysis

- Microsoft Office experience

OR

UA Analyst – Construction Property Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting, Finance, Accounting or Banking area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associates Degree and 2 or mor years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting, Finance, Accounting or Banking area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting, Insurance, Underwriting, Finance, Accounting or Banking area.
AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal and regulatory environment.

- Experience with data collection and analysis

- Experience with processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance industry. Knowledge of processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance or financial industry.

- Customer service experience

- Problem solving experience

- Experience servicing product portfolios for multiple lines of business for insurance or financial industry.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Insurance industry knowledge

- Knowledge of processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance industry

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Superior skills in relationship building, active listening with customers and coworkers

- Enjoys working with details and providing accurate data in a timely manner

- Self-directed to meet deadlines

- Multi-tasking skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $54,500.00 - $98,100.00. The proposed hourly rate for the UA Associate is $26.20- $42.84, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 5%. The proposed salary range for the UA Analyst is $60,000.00 - $98,100.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

jobs.description:
Especialista BI

Imagina trabajar en una empresa que realmente se preocupa por sus colaboradores, clientes, partes interesadas y toda la comunidad involucrada. ¡Imagínate trabajar para una empresa que se compromete con hacer lo correcto y que tiene como objetivo ser el mejor proveedor de seguros del mundo! Zurich es una de las principales compañías de seguros del mundo y una de las pocas que opera a escala global. Con alrededor de 55.000 empleados, dedicados a comprender las necesidades de nuestros clientes y ofrecer soluciones para particulares y empresas, desde pequeñas empresas hasta multinacionales.

Aquí, apostamos por la Sostenibilidad, innovando en las políticas de desarrollo y uniéndonos cada vez más con los cambios del mundo. Nos preocupamos por la confianza en la sociedad y en la forma en que estamos constantemente innovando, buscando tecnología y estrategias que nos permitan brindar una experiencia memorable a nuestro cliente.

También fomentamos una cultura de diversidad e inclusión. Nuestra declaración de propósito y valores está diseñada para proteger, inspirar confianza y ayudar a nuestros colaboradores a alcanzar su máximo potencial. Por eso, contamos con una política de inclusión laboral que promueve la selección de personas con discapacidad que cumplan con los requisitos de la vacante

¡Ven a ser un Zuricher y forma parte de nuestro equipo como Especialista BI!

#LI-Remote, #LI-Hybrid, #LI-Onsite

Tu objetivo será desarrollar, consolidar y transformar información relevante del negocio en soluciones visuales mediante tableros Power BI, que permitan a la organización tomar decisiones basadas en datos. Actuar como puente entre las necesidades estratégicas del negocio y su materialización en indicadores claros, gestionando eficientemente bases de datos, depurando, analizando y visualizando la información, para impulsar una cultura de datos alineada a la rentabilidad y objetivos clave de la compañía

Responsabilidades:

'*Integrar información de diversas fuentes internas y externas, asegurando su calidad, confiabilidad y consistencia para el análisis del negocio.
*Utilizar herramientas como Power Query, Power Pivot, SQL y R para depurar, estructurar y transformar datos en indicadores relevantes.
*Visualización y desarrollo de tableros: Crear tableros interactivos en Power BI que traduzcan necesidades y objetivos del negocio en visualizaciones claras, útiles y orientadas a la toma de decisiones.
*Traducción de requerimientos del negocio: Capturar y comprender ideas, necesidades y objetivos de las áreas clave, traduciendo estos en soluciones y números que reflejen la realidad y desafíos del negocio.
• *Análisis financiero: Identificar, analizar y visualizar los factores que impactan directamente la rentabilidad y los resultados financieros, proponiendo acciones y recomendaciones.
• *Verificación y consolidación de información: Validar la integridad de la información consolidada y verificar su congruencia entre diferentes bases y fuentes de datos.
• *Asesoría en visualización: Sugerir y asesorar a los owners de proyectos sobre la mejor forma de visualizar los datos, garantizando claridad y relevancia en los tableros entregados.
• *Creación de ciclo de transformación financiera: Diseñar y ejecutar procesos de transformación de datos orientados a dar seguimiento a indicadores clave para la gestión financiera.
• *Impulso de cultura de datos: Promover una cultura de trabajo basada en la toma de decisiones por datos, colaborando como aliado estratégico del equipo de BI dentro de la organización.
• *Comunicación efectiva: Explicar de forma clara y sencilla los resultados, hallazgos y propuestas al equipo financiero y stakeholders, facilitando la comprensión de la información.
• *Apoyo a proyectos especiales: Participar en iniciativas transversales asignadas por la gerencia de planeación de negocios, contribuyendo con análisis, visualización y reporte de datos.
• *Ejecutar otras funciones laborales solicitadas por su People Manager

Educación básica

jobs.title: Senior Data Science & Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis.

Location: Flexible – with some travel to our Swindon office where the UK Life team are based

Closing date for applications: 19th June 2026

The opportunity:

As Senior Data Science & Analytics Lead, you will play a pivotal role in evolving our data function from strong management information delivery to a data science-led, AI-enabled capability that drives measurable improvements in decision-making, operational efficiency and risk management.

You will be accountable for developing and deploying predictive and statistical models across complex datasets, embedding advanced analytics and AI into core business processes to move from insight generation to automated, data-driven decisioning. This includes ensuring solutions transition effectively from experimentation into robust, controlled and scalable production use.

Combining strong people leadership with technical credibility, this role will shape the future direction of analytics within UK Life, building sustainable capability, influencing senior stakeholders and ensuring advanced analytics and AI initiatives remain aligned to business priorities and governance expectations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning ambiguity into delivery, balancing people leadership with technical credibility, and innovation leadership – setting direction, coaching others, and acting as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders.

Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

What will you be doing?

Leadership & Team Management

- Lead, coach and develop a high-performing analytics team, establishing clear direction, building capability and creating a culture of innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.

- Act as a role model for modern analytics practices, curiosity, and outcome‑focused delivery.

- Build and mature analytical and AI capability within the team, coaching analysts toward more advanced analytics, automation, and AI techniques using learning from apprenticeships and hands‑on delivery.

Insight & Business Partnership

- Act as a trusted partner to senior leaders across UK Life, identifying opportunities where analytics, automation and AI can improve business performance, strengthen decision-making and deliver measurable outcomes.

- Translate complex business questions into analytical approaches that deliver clear, actionable outputs.

- Own a prioritised insight and automation development pipeline aligned to business value and capacity.

Analytics, Automation & AI Leadership

- Lead the design and delivery of advanced analytics and data science-driven solutions, including predictive insight, trend analysis, and decision-support models.

- Shape and oversee the responsible use of AI and GenAI to automate insight generation, controls and repeatable MI processes.

- Act as the accountable lead for exploratory AI and advanced analytics use cases, ensuring appropriate governance, ethics, and risk considerations are met.

- Guide the transition from pilot and proof-of-concept into robust, scalable BAU solutions in partnership with Data Engineering, Governance and Architecture.

- Embed model lifecycle thinking, including documentation, validation, monitoring, and ongoing performance management where applicable.

Ways of Working

- Embed standards for documentation, validation, and handover into BAU.

- Champion efficient tooling (e.g. Power BI, Power Platform, SQL, Python) and automation‑first thinking.

- Promote reuse, simplification, and scalability across the reporting estate.

- Embed experimentation frameworks (e.g. controlled testing, monitoring, feedback loops) to safely trial and scale advanced analytics and AI‑enabled solutions.

What are we looking for?

Essential

- Strong experience applying advanced analytics or data science-led approaches to ambiguous business problems within Financial Services or similarly regulated environments.

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and translate business strategy into analytical priorities.

- Proven ability to lead and develop analysts while remaining technically credible.

- Hands-on experience building and deploying predictive or statistical models in a business environment

- Strong working knowledge of Python (or equivalent) for data analysis and modelling

- Experience designing and applying experimentation techniques (e.g. A/B testing, hypothesis testing)

- Advanced skills in SQL and Power BI, including automation of data and MI workflows

- Experience delivering analytical solutions from prototype into production environments

- Confident communicator, able to influence stakeholders without relying on hierarchy.

- Experience working within structured delivery practices (e.g. agile/iterative delivery) including backlog and governance management using Azure DevOps or equivalent.

Desirable

- Experience scaling data science or analytics capability within a team or function

- Exposure to cloud-based data platforms or modern data ecosystems (e.g. Snowflake, AWS, Azure)

- Experience applying AI/GenAI techniques in a business context, including automation of insight generation or decisioning

- Strong understanding of data governance, controls and regulatory considerations within Financial Services

- Experience working in cross-functional delivery models with Data Engineering, Architecture and Governance teams

Qualifications & Learning

- Degree (or equivalent experience) in a numerate or analytical discipline such as mathematics, statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field.

- Professional qualifications, certifications, or structured learning in analytics, data science, automation, or AI (e.g. cloud data platforms, analytics engineering, machine learning, or responsible AI) are desirable.

- Commitment to continuous professional development, including keeping pace with emerging analytics, automation, and AI practices, and supporting the learning of others through coaching, apprenticeships, or structured development pathways.

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday, alongside a range of other flexible benefits

You can find out more about our wide range of employee benefits on our website .

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 65,000 employees, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company that is a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee: to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you’re interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment where your creativity, ideas and contributions are recognised and rewarded, Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our culture:

At Zurich, our strength comes from the diverse experiences, perspectives and talents of our people. Our goal is to create a workplace where every employee can flourish and where everyone feels valued, heard and respected.

Over a quarter of our employees are members of at least one of our inclusion communities (Employee Resource Groups), with groups focused on areas such as social mobility and cultural awareness. We’re proud to have received numerous industry awards recognising our diversity and inclusion policies and initiatives.

We’ve created an environment that places real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide practical advice and access to a wide range of lifestyle support, alongside opportunities to learn, grow and develop the skills needed for the future.

We actively support our employees to give back to their communities through volunteering and charitable activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest ‑ established corporate trusts in the UK. Together, we’ve supported causes across the UK through grants and volunteering, contributing over £100 million in funding and volunteered time.

Your application:

We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.

As an inclusive employer we also want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com

So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

Your health is important to us

- Virtual GP appointments.

- Discounted gym membership.

- Free flu jab.

- Access to a wealth of support from our wellbeing partners.

We're making a difference

- Creating a brighter, more sustainable future underpins all that we do here in Zurich. We were the first insurer to sign the ‘UN Business Ambition for 1.5˚C’ pledge.
