Vous aimez mettre les cas de dommages à l'épreuve et chercher des façons intelligentes d'utiliser le potentiel de régression de façon cohérente et équitable? Dans ce rôle, vous vous concentrez sur l'application ciblée des recours en assurance de la propriété et de la responsabilité et contribuez ainsi de façon significative à la qualité des résultats et au professionnalisme de notre secteur de réclamation. Vous combinez le savoir-faire juridique et d'assurance et utilisez vos compétences de négociation pour trouver des solutions viables avec un large éventail de parties prenantes.

En tant que spécialiste des recours, vous évaluez les recours potentiels, effectuez des recours actifs en fonction de la situation juridique et développez notre reconnaissance systématique des recours avec des spécialistes. Dans le même temps, vous travaillez avec des entreprises partenaires pour assurer une mise en œuvre réussie des recours à l'étranger et assurer le recouvrement de la dette. Vous transmettez vos connaissances à vos collègues lors de sessions de formation et de coaching et contribuez ainsi à professionnaliser les processus de régression et à créer une valeur ajoutée durable pour Zurich et nos clients.

Vous appréciez le travail analytique, comme prendre des responsabilités et vouloir faire progresser le monde des dommages avec des méthodes modernes et le travail basé sur les données? Ensuite, une tâche variée vous attend avec nous, dans laquelle vous pouvez apporter pleinement votre expertise, votre confiance en négociation et votre esprit d'équipe.

Découvrez ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse est l'un des employeurs "Top 3" en Suisse. Devenez partie intégrante et faites une demande en tant que spécialiste des recours pour les biens et la détention.

Ce que tu fais

- Vous contrôlez et activez les recours actifs selon la situation juridique – en mettant l'accent sur l'assurance matérielle et technique.

- Vous négociez avec d'autres compagnies d'assurance et des débiteurs de recours du secteur privé et des entreprises.

- Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires internes et des entreprises partenaires externes, en particulier dans les recours étrangers, et vous assurez le recouvrement de la dette.

- Vous développerez la base des procédures judiciaires et favoriserez ainsi une application efficace de la loi.

- Vous contribuez au développement d'une reconnaissance moderne et systémique des recours et apportez votre savoir-faire aux projets et aux groupes de travail.

Ce que vous apportez

- Diplôme de droit suisse ou carrière d'assurance avec plusieurs années d'expérience en dommages complexes

- Connaissance approfondie du droit de la responsabilité et des recours dans le domaine des dommages matériels.

- Profitez des négociations avec les assureurs et d'autres parties ainsi que d'une solide assurance.

- L'allemand comme langue maternelle et la bonne connaissance du français; l'anglais et l'italien sont bénéfiques.

- Un niveau élevé de compétence sociale, de travail d'équipe et de volonté de partager des connaissances – par exemple par la formation et le soutien professionnel sur des sujets de régression.

Within our personal insurance department (LAA, LAAC, sickness loss compensation), you are the first contact person for our clients and you manage sickness claims from beginning to end. This role, you understand not only as the duty to help your customers but above all as an opportunity to develop and maintain a good relationship with our customers.

At Zurich, we offer the opportunity to practice an exciting profession as well as the opportunity to develop new skills. Taking care of our clients and working as a team will be part of your daily life.

Are you organized, effective and have good experience in managing daily allowances? Then you're the person we're looking for!

Find out why Zurich Switzerland is part of the "Top 3" price of the best employer in Switzerland. Become a member as well and apply as a Disease Claims Manager.

What You Do

- You independently manage and customer-oriented claims files

- You apply the regulation of benefits according to the legal and contractual provisions

- You work closely with our various partners and write decisions

- You correspond and conduct interviews with the various parties involved in settling a claim (insurers, employers, medical service, other insurers, lawyers, ...)

- You detect remedies against responsible third parties and other insurers

What you bring

- Commercial training completed, Federal Social Insurance Patent is an asset

- Professional experience in disaster management

- Excellent knowledge of Swiss social security and private insurance

- Reliable, empathic personality, excellent bargaining capacity and professional attitude towards clients

- Excellent mastery of French and German, both oral and written

L'idea di creare e sviluppare un'esperienza positiva per i nostri partner broker e clienti aziendali ti ispira con un team motivato?

In qualità di specialista BVG in Customer Service Broker Svizzera di lingua tedesca, si consiglia ai nostri partner broker e clienti aziendali e di essere il punto centrale di contatto per tutte le domande relative al BVG. Grazie alle tue capacità comunicative e all'impegno, puoi dare un contributo significativo alla storia del successo di Zurigo Svizzera.

Avete conoscenze specialistiche nel campo delle pensioni professionali, date l'eccellenza del cliente per scontato, e vi piace lavorare in un team così come con i partner di vendita e broker? Allora questo lavoro è giusto per te!

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come specialista BVG.

Cosa fai

- Gestisci in modo indipendente un portafoglio cliente/broker assegnato e assicurati il coordinamento con la gestione dell'assicurazione

- Elabori tutte le mutazioni contrattuali come nuove imprese, acquisizioni, cambiamenti di piano, cancellazioni contrattuali e gestione account

- Elabori mutazioni assicurative, comprese le registrazioni, la cessazione del servizio e le mutazioni personali

- Supporti il processo di vendita dall'analisi delle esigenze alla conclusione del contratto

- Supporti proattivamente le unità di vendita e distribuzione e mantieni il contatto telefonico e scritto con broker, clienti, persone assicurate, autorità e avvocati

Cosa porti

- Formazione commerciale completata, idealmente nel settore assicurativo

- L'ulteriore formazione nel settore delle pensioni professionali o dei relativi argomenti è un vantaggio

- Esperienza in pensioni professionali e assistenza clienti che ti aiuta a capire e soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti

- Personalità orientata al cliente con un approccio orientato al servizio e alla soluzione che svolge attività in modo indipendente e affidabile

- Iniziativa, squadra capace e resiliente personalità con ottime capacità di comunicazione che mantiene una testa fresca in situazioni difficili

- Confidente tedesco e una buona conoscenza del francese ogni altra lingua è benefica e facilita la comunicazione con i nostri diversi clienti

Il tuo contatto

Talent Acquisizione Consulente: Silke Nachtigall +41 44 628 2059

Ulteriori informazioni

Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: 80 - 100%

Luogo di lavoro: Zurigo, Oerlikon

Ibridi di lavoro: fino al 40%

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online – anche senza una lettera di richiesta.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. La base del nostro successo è la nostra 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, che aiutano i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere meglio se stessi dai loro rischi. Al fine di fornire prestazioni quotidiane, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di formazione. Come dipendente di Zurigo, si beneficia di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una forte cultura caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e orientamento del team.

A Zurigo, coltiviamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, promuovere la fiducia e aiutarli a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. L'acquisizione dei nostri talenti e dei processi di reclutamento riflettono questo impegno nella vita quotidiana. Unisciti a noi e diventare parte di questa cultura.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Vedere qui e diventare parte di esso.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Does the idea of creating and developing a positive experience for our broker partners and corporate clients inspire you with a motivated team?

As a BVG specialist in Customer Service Broker German-speaking Switzerland, you will advise our broker partners and corporate clients and be the central point of contact for all questions relating to the BVG. Thanks to your communication skills and commitment, you make a significant contribution to the success story of Zurich Switzerland.

Do you have specialist knowledge in the field of occupational pensions, do you take customer excellence for granted, and do you enjoy working in a team as well as with sales and broker partners? Then this job is just right for you!

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a BVG specialist.

What you do

- You independently manage an assigned client/broker portfolio and ensure coordination with the insurance management

- You process all contract mutations such as new business, acquisitions, plan changes, contract cancellations and account management

- You process insured mutations, including registrations, termination of service and personal mutations

- You support the sales process from needs analysis to contract conclusion

- You proactively support the sales and distribution units and maintain telephone and written contact with brokers, customers, insured persons, authorities and lawyers

What you bring

- Completed basic commercial training, ideally in the insurance industry

- Further training in the field of occupational pensions or related topics is an advantage

- Experience in occupational pensions and customer support that helps you understand and meet the needs of our customers

- Customer-oriented personality with a service- and solution-oriented approach that performs tasks independently and reliably

- Initiative, team capable and resilient personality with very good communication skills that keeps a cool head in challenging situations

- Confident German and a good knowledge of French every other language is beneficial and facilitates communication with our diverse customers

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Silke Nachtigall +41 44 628 2059

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrids working: up to 40%

#LI-Hybrid

We look forward to your online application – even without an application letter.
You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

En tant que spécialiste en BVG du Service à la clientèle Courtier Suisse germanophone, vous conseillerez nos partenaires courtiers et clients corporatifs et serez le point de contact central pour toutes les questions relatives au BVG. Grâce à vos compétences en communication et votre engagement, vous contribuez de manière significative au succès de Zurich Suisse.

Avez-vous des connaissances spécialisées dans le domaine des pensions professionnelles, considérez-vous l'excellence client comme acquise, et aimez-vous travailler en équipe ainsi qu'avec des partenaires de vente et de courtage? Alors ce travail est juste pour vous !

- Vous traitez les mutations assurées, y compris les inscriptions, la cessation de service et les mutations personnelles

- Vous soutenez activement les unités de vente et de distribution et maintenez des contacts téléphoniques et écrits avec les courtiers, les clients, les assurés, les autorités et les avocats

Ce que vous apportez

- Formation commerciale de base, idéalement dans le secteur des assurances

- La formation continue dans le domaine des pensions professionnelles ou des matières connexes est un avantage

- Expérience en pensions professionnelles et soutien à la clientèle qui vous aide à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins de nos clients

- Personnalité orientée client avec une approche axée sur le service et la solution qui effectue les tâches de manière indépendante et fiable

- Initiative, personnalité capable d'équipe et résiliente avec de très bonnes compétences de communication qui maintient une tête cool dans des situations difficiles

- L'allemand confiant et une bonne connaissance du français toutes les autres langues est bénéfique et facilite la communication avec nos différents clients

Votre contact

Consultant en acquisition de talents: Silke Nachtigall +41 44 628 2059

Lieu de travail: Zurich, Oerlikon

Bist du auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung, bei der du deine Expertise im Versicherungswesen gezielt einsetzen kannst? Verfügst du über fundierte Fachkenntnisse und Erfahrung im Bereich Motorfahrzeug-Schaden und zeichnest dich durch ein hohes Mass an Empathie im Umgang mit Menschen aus?

Zum Schutz unserer ehrlichen Kundinnen und Kunden bekämpft Zurich entschlossen den Versicherungsbetrug und -missbrauch und setzt hierfür spezialisierte Fachkräfte ein.

In der Abteilung Bekämpfung von Versicherungsmissbrauch (BVM) bist du für die eigenständige Ermittlung und Bearbeitung von Schadenfällen mit Verdacht auf Missbrauch und Betrug im Bereich Motorfahrzeuge verantwortlich. Zusätzlich leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zum weiteren Ausbau des Themenbereichs Fraud bei Zurich und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer spezialisierten Ermittlungsaktivitäten aktiv mit.

Wenn du gerne selbstständig in einem eingespielten Team arbeitest, ein hohes Mass an Selbstvertrauen mitbringst und eigenmotiviert bist, dann könnte dies deine neue Herausforderung sein.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Claims Fraud Senior Investigator (Betrugsermittler) Motorfahrzeuge, Region Biel Jura.

Was du tust

- Du bearbeitest eigenverantwortlich und selbständig komplexe, betrugsverdächtige Schadenfälle im Bereich Motorfahrzeuge und koordinierst die weiteren Abklärungen mit internen und externen Partnern.

- Du führst eine angemessene und professionelle Kommunikation mit allen involvierten Parteien.

- Du vertrittst die Interessen der Versicherungsgesellschaft in Zivil- und Strafverfahren.

- Du wirkst aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung der Betrugsbekämpfung mit und initiierst Verbesserungen im Themenbereich Fraud.

- Du unterstützt die Schulung und Weiterbildung unserer Schadensachbearbeitenden in Bezug auf das Erkennen von Verdachtsfällen.

Was du mitbringst

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Polizistin oder Polizist sowie mehrjährige Tätigkeit bei einer Kriminalpolizei und/oder auf dem Gebiet der Bekämpfung von Versicherungsmissbrauch.

- Technisches Verständnis und Interesse an der Motorfahrzeugbranche.

- Erfahrung in der Betrugsermittlung und/oder in vergleichbaren Tätigkeiten, z.B. bei der Polizei oder in verwandten Ermittlungsbereichen.

- Hohe Qualitäts- und Kundenorientierung, verbunden mit Verschwiegenheit, Diskretion, Flexibilität und ausgezeichneten Umgangsformen.

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Französischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (bilangue) sind zwingend erforderlich; zusätzliche Fremdsprachenkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Sei alla ricerca di una nuova sfida dove è possibile utilizzare la vostra esperienza in assicurazione? Hai una conoscenza approfondita e un'esperienza nel campo dei danni dei veicoli a motore e sei caratterizzato da un alto grado di empatia nel trattare con le persone?

Combattito per proteggere i nostri clienti onesti Zurigo affronta risolutamente le frodi di assicurazione e abusi e impiega specialisti a questo scopo.

Nel Dipartimento per la lotta contro l'abuso di assicurazione (BVM), si è responsabili per l'indagine indipendente e l'elaborazione di reclami con presunti abusi e frodi nel settore dei veicoli a motore. Inoltre, Lei contribuisce in modo importante all'ulteriore espansione del tema delle frodi a Zurigo e forma attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo delle nostre attività di indagine specializzate.

Se ti piace lavorare in modo indipendente in un team consolidato, avere un alto grado di fiducia in se stessi e sono auto-motivati, questa potrebbe essere la tua nuova sfida.

Are you looking for a new challenge where you can use your expertise in insurance? Do you have in-depth knowledge and experience in the field of motor vehicle damage and are you characterized by a high degree of empathy in dealing with people?

Fighted to protect our honest customers Zurich resolutely tackles insurance fraud and abuse and employs specialists for this purpose.

In the Department for Combating Insurance Abuse (BVM), you are responsible for the independent investigation and processing of claims with suspected abuse and fraud in the motor vehicle sector. In addition, you make an important contribution to the further expansion of the topic of fraud at Zurich and actively shape the further development of our specialized investigation activities.

If you like to work independently in a well-established team, have a high degree of self-confidence and are self-motivated, this could be your new challenge.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a Claims Fraud Senior Investigator Motor Vehicles, Biel Jura Region.

What you do

- You will handle complex, fraud-suspicious claims in the area of motor vehicles independently and coordinate further investigations with internal and external partners.

- You will maintain appropriate and professional communication with all parties involved.

- You represent the interests of the insurance company in civil and criminal proceedings.

- You actively participate in the further development of the fight against fraud and initiate improvements in the area of fraud.

- You support the training and further education of our damage handlers regarding the detection of suspected cases.

What you bring

- Successfully completed training as a police officer and several years of work at a criminal police and/or in the field of combating insurance abuse.

- Technical understanding and interest in the motor vehicle industry.

- Experience in fraud investigation and/or in comparable activities, e.g. in the police or in related investigation areas.

- High quality and customer orientation, combined with confidentiality, discretion, flexibility and excellent manners.

- Very good German and French skills in word and writing (bilangue) are mandatory; Additional foreign language skills are beneficial.

Your contact

Vous cherchez un nouveau défi où vous pouvez utiliser votre expertise en assurance? Avez-vous une connaissance approfondie et une expérience dans le domaine des dommages aux véhicules automobiles et êtes-vous caractérisé par un degré élevé d'empathie dans le traitement des personnes?

Dans le département de la lutte contre les abus d'assurance (BVM), vous êtes responsable de l'enquête indépendante et du traitement des demandes de remboursement avec des abus et des fraudes présumés dans le secteur des véhicules automobiles. En outre, vous apportez une contribution importante à l'élargissement du sujet de la fraude à Zurich et façonnez activement le développement de nos activités d'investigations spécialisées.

Si vous aimez travailler de façon indépendante dans une équipe bien établie, avoir un haut degré de confiance en soi et être automotivé, cela pourrait être votre nouveau défi.

- Vous traiterez les réclamations complexes et douteuses dans le domaine des véhicules automobiles de façon indépendante et coordonnerez les enquêtes avec les partenaires internes et externes.

- Vous participez activement au développement de la lutte contre la fraude et entrez dans le domaine de la fraude.

- Il a suivi avec succès une formation de policier et plusieurs années de travail dans une police criminelle et/ou dans le domaine de la lutte contre les abus d'assurance.

jobs.title: Executive Chauffeur 80-100%
jobs.description:
We provide safe and secure ground transfers to senior executives and their guests by offering services which are on par with their daily itineraries. This also includes the proactive management of the company’s own car fleet, maintaining vehicles and keeping them in exceptional operating conditions.

We ensure MOBILITY...
...to keep Zurich MOVING

What you will do

- Organize transportation for our senior leaders / board members.

- Transport our Executives in a comfortable, safe and timely manner

- Carry out general travel orders, also outside normal working hours

- Be responsible for the assigned vehicle and ensure that it is operational

- Temporarily take on further administrative tasks within the organizational unit

What you bring

- Fully qualified/licensed Limousine, Bus or any other type of people transportation professional chauffeur with all CH Driving Permits (BPT/121) acquired

- Min. 8 years’ experience in servicing industry (Limousine-/VIP-Transportation, Hospitality)

- Positive, confident and service-oriented personality

- Strong verbal communication skills in German and English

- Dynamic and fit

- Discreet, polite and highly reliable with a clean criminal record

- Domiciled within the area of our Quai Zurich Headquarters (max. 45 Min commute)

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.

Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Wir bieten sichere und sichere Bodentransfers für Führungskräfte und ihre Gäste, indem wir Dienstleistungen anbieten, die ihren täglichen Reiserouten entsprechen. Dazu gehört auch das proaktive Management der eigenen Fahrzeugflotte, die Wartung der Fahrzeuge und deren Einhaltung unter außergewöhnlichen Betriebsbedingungen.

Wir sorgen für Mobilität...
...um Zürich in Bewegung zu halten

Was du tun wirst

- Organisieren Sie den Transport für unsere leitenden Führungskräfte / Vorstandsmitglieder.

- Transportieren Sie unsere Führungskräfte auf komfortable, sichere und zeitnahe Weise

- Durchführung von allgemeinen Reiseaufträgen, auch außerhalb der normalen Arbeitszeit

- Seien Sie für das zugewiesene Fahrzeug verantwortlich und stellen Sie sicher, dass es funktionsfähig ist

- Vorübergehend weitere administrative Aufgaben innerhalb der Organisationseinheit übernehmen

Was du mitbringst

- Voll qualifiziert / lizenziert Limousine, Bus oder jede andere Art von Personen Transport professioneller Chauffeur mit allen CH Führerscheine erworben (BPT/121)

- Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Servicebranche (Limousine-/VIP-Transportation, Hospitality)

- Positive, selbstbewusste und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit

- Starke verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

- Dynamisch und fit

- Diskret, höflich und sehr zuverlässig mit einem sauberen Vorstrafenregister

- Domiziliert im Bereich unseres Quai Zürich Hauptsitzes (max. 45 Min pendeln)

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.

Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.
Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.

Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!

jobs.title: Pricing Aktuar Special Lines (m/w/d) 70-100%
jobs.description:
Bist du Aktuar oder Data Scientist mit Begeisterung für Versicherungen? Möchtest du mit deinen kreativen Ideen im Team Special Lines Pricing unser Geschäftsfeld voranbringen?

In deiner Rolle als Pricing Aktuar Special Lines kombinierst du dein technisches Fachwissen mit ausgeprägtem Geschäftsverständnis, um für unsere internationalen Kunden komplexe und massgeschneiderte Versicherungslösungen im Bereich der Krankenversicherung zu entwickeln. Zudem arbeitest du an der Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung von Tarif- und Portfoliosteuerungslösungen im Segment Special Lines für das internationale Grosskundengeschäft.

Für diese Position suchen wir einen motivierten Kandidaten mit einem hohen Mass an Eigeninitiative und technischem Know-how. In einem dynamischen und marktnahen Umfeld suchst du nach den besten Lösungen – und setzt diese konsequent um.

Bist du bereit, dein Zahlenflair und deinen Geschäftssinn einzubringen, um gemeinsam mit uns die besten Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln?

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Pricing Aktuar Special Lines.

Was du tust

- Du übernimmst die aktive Verantwortung für die Preisgestaltung unserer Versicherungsprodukte für Firmenkunden und arbeitest als Business Partner eng mit dem Underwriting zusammen

- Du entwickelst im Team aktuarielle Modelle und Portfoliosteuerungsansätze und nutzt dabei spannende Möglichkeiten zur Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung

- Du konzipierst und implementierst Tarife, Pricing-Tools sowie Massnahmen zur Erreichung unserer Ziele

- Du bereitest quantitative Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Tarif- und Produktentscheide auf – stets unter Berücksichtigung der Marktentwicklungen

- Du bringst innovative Ideen in die Produktgestaltung ein und unterstützt deren Umsetzung aktiv

Was du mitbringst

- Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss mit Schwerpunkt in einem quantitativen Bereich wie Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder Physik

- Erfahrung im Pricing von P&C Risiken und des Schweizer Versicherungsmarktes sowie ausgeprägtes analytisches und unternehmerisches Denkvermögen, selbstständige Arbeitsweise

- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen R oder Python für Modellierung und Datenanalyse und im Bereich Machine-Learning

- Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Azure Synapse sind von Vorteil

- Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, sehr gute Französischkenntnisse

Dein Kontakt

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Philippe Frutiger (+41 44 628 32 20)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 70 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Reisetätigkeit: bis zu 10%

Hybride s Arbeiten: bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung – auch ohne Bewerbungsschreiben.
Gerne kannst du uns bei einem persönlichen Kennenlernen von deiner Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind geschaffen, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen, Vertrauen zu fördern und zu helfen, ihr volles Potential auszuschöpfen. Wir stehen ein für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichheit unter unseren Angestellten, unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, etc. Die Gewinnung unserer Talente sowie die Rekrutierungsprozesse spiegeln dieses Bekenntnis im Alltag. Steige bei uns ein und werde Teil dieser Kultur.

Weshalb ist Zurich seit über 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Siehe hier selbst und werde Teil davon .

Information f ür Personalvermittler

Zurich nimmt für diese Position keine unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern entgegen. Personalvermittler reichen daher bitte keine Bewerberunterlagen an unsere Mitarbeitenden oder über unser Online-Karriere-Portal ein. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen sowie etwaige Gebühren ab und danken für das Verständnis.

Nel vostro ruolo di Pricing Actuar Special Lines, combinate la vostra competenza tecnica con una forte comprensione aziendale per sviluppare soluzioni di assicurazione sanitaria complesse e personalizzate per i nostri clienti internazionali. Per questa posizione, stiamo cercando un candidato motivato con un alto grado di iniziativa e know-how tecnico. In un ambiente dinamico e orientato al mercato, si cerca le migliori soluzioni – e implementarle costantemente.

Siete pronti a contribuire le vostre figure e business acum per sviluppare le migliori soluzioni per i nostri clienti insieme a noi?

- Conoscenza fluida del tedesco e dell'inglese, ottima conoscenza del francese

In your role as Pricing Actuar Special Lines, you combine your technical expertise with a strong business understanding to develop complex and customized health insurance solutions for our international customers. In addition, you will work on the conception and further development of tariff and portfolio management solutions in the Special Lines segment for international large customer business.

For this position, we are looking for a motivated candidate with a high degree of initiative and technical know-how. In a dynamic and market-oriented environment, you search for the best solutions – and implement them consistently.

Are you ready to contribute your figures and business acumen to develop the best solutions for our customers together with us?

What you do

- You take active responsibility for the pricing of our insurance products for corporate customers and work closely with underwriting as a business partner

- You will develop actuarial models and portfolio management approaches in a team and use exciting opportunities for co-creation and further development

- You design and implement tariffs, pricing tools and measures to achieve our goals

- You prepare quantitative decision-making bases for tariff and product decisions – always taking into account market developments

- You bring innovative ideas to the product design and actively support their implementation

What you bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree with an emphasis in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, data science or physics

- Experience in pricing P&C risks and the Swiss insurance market as well as strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, independent working methods

- Extensive knowledge of programming languages R or Python for modeling and data analysis and in the field of machine learning

Do you want to contribute your technical expertise in an environment of complex business applications in the sense of customer benefit?

As a team within Information & Technology at Zurich Insurance, we provide all insurance-specific IT services for the Swiss Life division. To strengthen our team, we are looking for you as a Senior Software Engineer.

As part of our development team, does it appeal to you to actively shape the further development of our IT landscape together with the business and to drive the technical implementation? Then many exciting challenges await you with us.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 5" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as Senior Software Engineer Java and Angular.

What you do

- You are part of our development team and participate in the development, maintenance and integration of applications as well as the individualization and integration of industry platforms of external suppliers

- You are responsible for sustainable conception, technical implementation, operation, observability and security

- Ensure quality by performing mutual code reviews and test automation

- You support the further development of our development process and the implementation of production deployments

- You get involved beyond pure software development: you analyze requirements and develop concrete, technically feasible solutions from them

What you bring

- University degree (ETH, university of applied sciences, etc.) in computer science, business informatics or comparable professional experience and Czech expertise and many years of experience in the development, integration and operation of software in complex business environments (Java, Angular and SOAP / rest knowledge, C as plus)

- Experience in IT life insurance and partner data management environment

- Knowledge of current DevOps and cloud technologies and their use in agile software development

- Enjoyment of working in a team, strong initiative and high willingness to take on responsibility

- Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English in word and writing

Your contact

Is it your passion to help other people while being able to use your languages on a daily basis? Do you love the variety and keep the overview even in hectic times?

The Direct, Digital & Customer Care division is the central customer service and direct sales unit of Zurich Switzerland. An important task of the area is to ensure the SOS emergency call center (First Level), through which we support our customers in emergency situations as a strong partner. As a specialist in the SOS First Level, you will advise our customers in emergency situations by telephone and organize immediate measures, such as breakdown cases and household effects or the credit card blocking service.

Are you inspired by the idea of being the first person to contact our customers in an emergency situation together with a passionate team? Then you could be the right person for this exciting job.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a specialist SOS First Level (m/f/d) 80 - 100%.

What you do

- You take calls from insured persons, partners and internal offices in different languages

- You organize immediate measures and coordinate in the areas: roadside assistance, return transport of passenger cars and their occupants as well as property insurance cases in Germany

- You are responsible for the written and telephone correspondence with insured persons and partners as well as the daily processing of subsequent orders

- You occasionally assist in motor vehicle damage

What you bring

- Completed vocational training and/or professional experience in a comparable customer service activity

- Rapid comprehension, high customer, service and solution orientation

- Flexibility in operational planning (Monday – Friday: early, medium and late shifts between 6:00 and 22:30)

- Good MS-Office knowledge

- Very good knowledge of German (Swiss German), fluent French, Italian advantageous

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Eleni Bourtzakis +41 44 628 20 51

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

jobs.description:
コンタクトセンターオペレーター（スーパーバイザー・スーパーバイザー候補）

【採用背景】

• ダイレクトビジネスに主軸を置く同社において、重要ポジションとなるコンタクトセンターでの業務拡大により増員となります
• ※今回は管理者候補の採用です。フィンテックの進化やデジタル化の加速に対応し、新しい価値をお客様に届けるための変革を推進しています
• ※オペレーションの簡素化やAIを活用した業務効率化を進め、より高品質なカスタマーサービスを実現します。こうした変化に前向きに取り組み、新しい仕組みやテクノロジーを柔軟に取り入れられる方を歓迎します。

【職務内容】

• 当社のコンタクトセンターで、お客様からのお問い合わせに対応し、契約や各種手続きをサポートしていただきます。
• 電話・メール・LINE・チャットなど、幅広いチャネルを活用しながら、お客様の「安心」を支えるお仕事です。
• カスタマーハラスメント対策ガイドラインを整備しており、従業員を守る体制が整っています。

■入社後の流れ
• 2～3か月間の充実した研修をご用意しています。
• 商品知識やシステム操作、応対スキルをしっかり学んだうえで現場デビューできます。
• 研修後も、先輩やSVによるフォロー体制が整っており、安心して業務に取り組めます。

■具体的には
• 保険料や補償内容のご案内、見積書の作成、契約手続きのサポート
• 契約内容の変更や解約など、ライフステージに応じた保全手続き
• 保険証券や異動承認書の発行など、正確でスピーディーな事務処理

【必須スキル・人物像】

■ 販売・接客経験者
• ■ 基本的なPCスキル（Word・Excelなど）をお持ちの方
• ■ 人と関わることが好きで、相手の気持ちを理解しながら対応できる方■ チームで協力しながら仕事を進められる方
• ■ ルールを守り、正確さを大切にできる方
• ■ 新しいことを学ぶ意欲があり、前向きに取り組める方
• ■ 自分で考え、主体的に行動できる方
• ■ 柔軟性があり、積極的に物事に取り組める方

【歓迎スキル・経験】

■ 損害保険業界での業務経験
• ■ コンタクトセンターやコールセンターでの勤務経験（業界不問）
• ■ チームリーダーやSVとしてのマネジメント経験■ PC操作や複数システムを使った業務経験

【キャリアアップ・働きやすさ】

• 未経験でも3年後に、経験者であれば2年後にSVを目指せる明確なキャリアパスを用意しています。
• 入社1年以内： お客さま対応スキル、業務遂行スキルを習得
• 入社2年目～ リーダー職として新人研修参加、後進育成、プロジェクトにメンバーとして参画する入社3年～ コールセンター管理者（SV）として、新人研修講師を担当。
• SVチームメンバーのスキルアップに責任を持つ、プロジェクトにチームリーダーとして参画する。

～待遇～

■給与
• 当社規程により決定
• ☆前職の経験/スキルを考慮

■勤務時間

労働時間区分：シフト制

就業時間：9時00分から18時00分の間で実働7時間・休憩1時間のシフト勤務

補足事項：土日祝を含むシフト勤務制(週5日勤務)

■休日休暇

完全週休2日制、年次有給休暇(半日・一部1時間単位取得可能)、リフレッシュ休暇、年末年始休暇、慶弔休暇、ほか ☆2024年年間休日実績 123日

■契約期間

期間定めなし

試用期間あり（6か月）

■勤務地

〒560-0082 大阪府豊中市新千里東町 1-5-3 千里朝日阪急ビル 19 階

採用背景
- ダイレクトビジネスに主軸を置く同社において、重要ポジションとなるコンタクトセンターでの業務拡大により増員となります
- 管理者候補の採用です。フィンテックの進化やデジタル化の加速に対応し、新しい価値をお客様に届けるための変革を推進しています
- オペレーションの簡素化やAIを活用した業務効率化を進め、より高品質なカスタマーサービスを実現します。こうした変化に前向きに取り組み、新しい仕組みやテクノロジーを柔軟に取り入れられる方を歓迎します。

職務内容
- 当社のコンタクトセンターで、お客様からのお問い合わせに対応し、契約や各種手続きをサポートしていただきます。
- 電話・メール・LINE・チャットなど、幅広いチャネルを活用しながら、お客様の「安心」を支えるお仕事です。
- カスタマーハラスメント対策ガイドラインを整備しており、従業員を守る体制が整っています。

入社後の流れ
- 2～3か月間の充実した研修をご用意しています。
- 商品知識やシステム操作、応対スキルをしっかり学んだうえで現場デビューできます。
- 研修後も、先輩やSVによるフォロー体制が整っており、安心して業務に取り組めます。

具体的には
- 保険料や補償内容のご案内、見積書の作成、契約手続きのサポート
- 契約内容の変更や解約など、ライフステージに応じた保全手続き
- 保険証券や異動承認書の発行など、正確でスピーディーな事務処理

必須スキル・人物像
- 販売・接客経験者
- 基本的なPCスキル（Word・Excelなど）をお持ちの方
- 人と関わることが好きで、相手の気持ちを理解しながら対応できる方
- チームで協力しながら仕事を進められる方
- ルールを守り、正確さを大切にできる方
- 新しいことを学ぶ意欲があり、前向きに取り組める方
- 自分で考え、主体的に行動できる方
- 柔軟性があり、積極的に物事に取り組める方

歓迎スキル・経験
- 損害保険業界での業務経験
- コンタクトセンターやコールセンターでの勤務経験（業界不問）
- チームリーダーやSVとしてのマネジメント経験
- PC操作や複数システムを使った業務経験

キャリアアップ・働きやすさ
- 未経験でも3年後に、経験者であれば2年後にSVを目指せる明確なキャリアパスを用意しています。
- 入社1年以内： お客さま対応スキル、業務遂行スキルを習得
- 入社2年目～ リーダー職として新人研修参加、後進育成、プロジェクトにメンバーとして参画する
- 入社3年～ コールセンター管理者（SV）として、新人研修講師を担当
- SVチームメンバーのスキルアップに責任を持つ、プロジェクトにチームリーダーとして参画する

待遇
- 給与
- 当社規程により決定
- ☆前職の経験/スキルを考慮
- 勤務時間
- 労働時間区分：シフト制
- 就業時間：9時00分から18時00分の間で実働7時間・休憩1時間のシフト勤務
- 補足事項：土日祝を含むシフト勤務制(週5日勤務)
- 休日休暇
- 完全週休2日制、年次有給休暇(半日・一部1時間単位取得可能)、リフレッシュ休暇、年末年始休暇、慶弔休暇、ほか
- ☆2024年年間休日実績 123日
- 福利厚生
- 各種社会保険(健康、厚生年金、雇用、労災、ほか)、団体生命保険、会員制福利厚生クラブ、育児休職制度、介護休職制度、退職年金制度、財形貯蓄制度、社内クラブ活動ほか
- 契約期間
- 期間定めなし
- 試用期間あり（6か月）

- 〒560-0082 大阪府豊中市新千里東町 1-5-3 千里朝日阪急ビル 19 階
- 喫煙：屋内原則禁煙（喫煙室有り）
- 勤務時間
- 労働時間区分：シフト制
- 就業時間：9:00～17:00（所定労働時間：7時間）
- 補足事項：土日祝を含むシフト勤務制(週5日勤務)
- 休日休暇

- ☆2022年年間休日実績 123日
- 福利厚生
- 各種社会保険(健康、厚生年金、雇用、労災、他)、団体生命保険、会員制福利厚生クラブ、財形貯蓄制度、社内クラブ活動ほか
- その他
- まずはオペレーターとして経験を積み、その後は入社後2年程度を目処に、オペレーターの育成やエスカレーション対応等のチーム内の実務管理を担う「スーパーバイザー」を目指してください。

- 提出書類

descriptionByLocale.it:
Job Title
Contact Center Operator (Supervisor Candidate)

Background
- In our company, which focuses on direct business, the role of the contact center is expanding, leading to an increase in personnel.
- This is a management candidate position. We are adapting to the advancement of fintech and digitalization, and we are promoting changes to deliver new value to our customers.
- We are simplifying operations and improving business efficiency through AI, aiming to achieve high-quality customer service. We welcome those who can adapt to new systems and technologies.

Duties
- Respond to customer inquiries and support contract and various procedures at our contact center.
- Use a variety of channels such as phone, email, LINE, and chat to ensure customer "trust" in our work.
- We have established a customer complaint management guideline and have a system in place to protect employees.

Onboarding Process
- We have prepared a comprehensive training program for 2 to 3 months.
- After training, you will be able to start your work with a solid understanding of product knowledge, system operation, and response skills.
- Even after training, there is a follow-up system with seniors and SVs, allowing you to work confidently.

Specific Tasks
- Provide information on insurance premiums and benefits, create estimates, and support contract procedures.
- Handle changes to contract terms or cancellations according to the customer's life stage.
- Issue insurance certificates, transfer documents, and other documents accurately and promptly.

Required Skills and Personal Traits
- Sales and reception experience
- Basic PC skills (Word, Excel, etc.)
- Enjoy interacting with people and understand their feelings while responding
- Work well in a team and can collaborate with others
- Follow rules and value accuracy
- Have a desire to learn new things and be proactive
- Think independently and take action
- Be flexible and actively engage in activities

Preferred Skills and Experience
- Experience in the insurance business
- Experience working in a contact center or call center (industry not specified)
- Experience as a team leader or SV in management
- Experience operating PCs or using multiple systems in business

Career Advancement and Work Environment
- We have a clear career path for both new and experienced employees.
- Within 1 year: Develop customer response and business execution skills.
- Within 2 years: Participate in new employee training, mentoring, and project participation as a team member.
- Within 3 years: Become a call center manager (SV) and take on the role of a new employee trainer.
- Take responsibility for team member skill development and participate in projects as a team leader.

Compensation
- Salary: Determined based on our company's regulations.
- ☆ Consider previous experience and skills.
- Working Hours
- Shift work: 9:00 to 18:00, 7 hours of work and 1 hour of break per day.
- Additional information: Shift work includes weekends and holidays (5 days a week).
- Vacation and Holidays
- 2-day workweek, annual paid leave (half-day or partial 1-hour units available), rest days, end-of-year holidays, bereavement leave, etc.
- ☆ 2024 Yearly Rest Day Record: 123 Days
- Welfare
- Various social insurance (health, pension, employment, etc.), company life insurance, membership-based welfare club, childcare leave system, care leave system, retirement pension system, savings system, etc.
- Contract Period
- No fixed term.
- There is a trial period (6 months).
- Work Location
- Osaka Office
- 560-0082 Osaka Prefecture, Sakai City, New Chikurin East Street 1-5-3, Chikurin Asahi Building 19th Floor
- Smoking: Indoor smoking prohibited (smoking room available)
- Working Hours
- Shift work: 9:00 to 17:00 (standard working hours: 7 hours)
- Additional information: Shift work includes weekends and holidays (5 days a week).
- Vacation and Holidays
- 2-day workweek, annual paid leave, end-of-year holidays, bereavement leave, flexible consecutive leave, volunteer leave, long-term service leave, etc.
- ☆ 2022 Yearly Rest Day Record: 123 Days
- Welfare
- Various social insurance (health, pension, employment, etc.), company life insurance, membership-based welfare club, savings system, etc.
- Other
- First, gain experience as an operator, and then, within 2 years of joining, focus on the development and escalation of operators within the team, and take on the role of "Supervisor" to manage internal business operations.

Selection
- Please submit the following documents to the system when you apply.
- Resume
- Employment History
- Job Description
- If you cannot submit through the system, please send them to the following email address.

- recruit_sh@zurich.co.jp

jobs.title: Senior Auditor Finanzen und Investments im Bereich Group Audit (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen ?

Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen?

Das erwartet dich

Die Zurich Group Audit ist ein vielfältiges internationales Team von über 275 Kolleg:innen aus 33 verschiedenen Nationen, das weltweit als eine Funktion mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel arbeitet: Zurich sicher zu halten. Gemeinsam bringen wir unsere Fähigkeiten, Kompetenzen und einzigartigen Stärken ein, um unseren Stakeholdern wertvolle Einblicke zu geben und positive Veränderungen voranzutreiben. Unser Anspruch ist es, das Beste für unser Unternehmen, unsere Mitarbeitenden und unsere Gemeinschaft zu sein. Wir engagieren uns für kontinuierliches Lernen und Verbesserung und streben danach, in dem, was wir tun und wie wir es tun, exzellent zu sein. Um dies zu unterstützen, transformieren wir uns zu einer vollständig digitalen, datengesteuerten und KI-gestützten Funktion, die unsere menschlichen Fähigkeiten durch technologische Innovation maximiert.

Als Senior Auditor:in mit einem Finance und Investment Schwerpunkt arbeitest du mit Mitgliedern des Audit-Teams in allen Aspekten einer Prüfung – von der Planung, der Festlegung des Umfangs, der Bewertung wesentlicher Risiken, der Konzeption und operativen Beurteilung bis hin zur Berichterstellung. Du arbeitest mit Teammitgliedern aus Group Audit zusammen und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für das Geschäft und seine Risiken. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr hochwertige Prüfungsansätze, einschließlich der Nutzung von Data Analytics, der Bewertung von IT-Grundlagen und dem Einsatz von GenAI. Zudem unterstützt du die Erstellung von Berichten, die wichtige Erkenntnisse liefern und Stakeholder in Deutschland beeinflussen.

Du förderst ein kollaboratives, lernorientiertes Teamumfeld und trägst zu strategischen Prioritäten bei. Du lernst und wendest innovative Prüfungsansätze sowie „New World Skills“ (Data Analytics, IT) an. Folgende interessante Aufgaben erwarten dich bei uns:

- Wertstiftende Audits: Du unterstützt die fristgerechte Durchführung von wirkungsvollen Audits in außergewöhnlicher Qualität. Du nutzt Data Analytics und GenAI und bewertest IT-Grundlagen während des gesamten Prüfungsprozesses.

- Aussagekräftige Berichterstattung: Du wirkst bei der Erstellung prägnanter und wirkungsvoller Feststellungen mit.

- Starke Beziehungen aufbauen: Du baust konstruktive Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern während der Audits auf und pflegst sie.

- Lernkultur fördern: Du übernimmst eine aktive Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung deiner fachlichen, digitalen und sozialen Kompetenzen und wendest eine Wachstums- und Lernmentalität an.

Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo riviviamo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

Il Gruppo Audit di Zurigo è un team internazionale diversificato di oltre 275 colleghi di 33 diverse nazioni, che lavorano in tutto il mondo in funzione con un obiettivo comune: mantenere la sicurezza di Zurigo. Insieme, portiamo le nostre competenze, competenze e punti di forza unici per dare ai nostri stakeholder preziose intuizioni e guidare cambiamenti positivi. La nostra missione è di essere il migliore per la nostra azienda, i nostri dipendenti e la nostra comunità. Ci impegniamo ad imparare e migliorare continuamente e ci sforziamo di essere eccellenti a quello che facciamo e come lo facciamo. Per supportarlo, ci stiamo trasformando in una funzione completamente digitale, data-driven e AI-powered che massimizza le nostre capacità umane attraverso l'innovazione tecnologica.

Come revisore senior: con un focus finanziario e di investimento, si lavora con i membri del team di audit in tutti gli aspetti di un audit – dalla pianificazione, determinazione della portata, valutazione dei rischi materiali, concezione e valutazione operativa alla reportistica. Potrai lavorare con i membri del team di Audit di Gruppo e sviluppare una profonda comprensione del business e dei suoi rischi. Insieme, si sviluppano approcci di auditing di alta qualità, tra cui l'uso di analisi dei dati, la valutazione dei fondamenti IT e l'uso di GenAI. Inoltre, supporta la creazione di report che forniscono informazioni importanti e influenzano gli stakeholder in Germania.

Si favorisce un ambiente di team collaborativo e orientato all'apprendimento e contribuisce alle priorità strategiche. Imparerai e applicherai approcci di esame innovativi e “New World Skills” (data analytics, IT). I seguenti compiti interessanti vi aspettano con noi:

- Audit di creazione di valore: Supporti l'esecuzione tempestiva di audit efficaci in qualità eccezionale. Si utilizza l'analisi dei dati e GenAI per valutare i fondamenti IT durante il processo di audit.

- Rapporto significativo: Contribuisci alla creazione di risultati concisi ed efficaci.

- Costruire relazioni forti: si costruisce e mantenere relazioni costruttive con gli stakeholder durante gli audit.

- Promuovere la cultura dell'apprendimento: assumete un ruolo attivo nell'ulteriore sviluppo delle vostre competenze professionali, digitali e sociali e applicate una mentalità di crescita e apprendimento.

- Usa nuove competenze: svilupperai attivamente le tue “New World Skills”: Dati, IT e GenAI e riconoscono la loro importanza per i risultati ottimali dell'esame e la protezione futura delle vostre competenze.

- Collaborazione come unità: Lei lavora insieme a tutti i livelli durante i controlli per ottenere i migliori risultati possibili.

- Mantenere l'etica e l'integrità: si impostano i più elevati standard di etica e di integrità e si assicurano il rispetto di tutti gli standard pertinenti, regolamenti e politiche interne.

Lo porti con te.

Personalmente, ci ispiri con le tue abilità di squadra forti e la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente se necessario!

Convinceteci con la vostra domanda significativa se le seguenti qualifiche vi distinguono anche:

- Corso di laurea o master in un campo rilevante o qualifica professionale equivalente (ad esempio CPA, CIA, CISA, MBA o equivalente)

- Molti anni di esperienza professionale in audit, gestione del rischio o conformità

- Esperienza in organizzazioni complesse, dinamiche e internazionali

- Buona conoscenza della metodologia di audit, standard di audit interno e quadro di controllo interno auspicabile

- Buona conoscenza della finanza, degli investimenti e dell'assicurazione sulla vita

- Esperienza e buona comprensione delle “New World Skills” (DA, ITGC e GenAI)

- Buone capacità di gestione del progetto, capacità di priorità e fornire risultati di alta qualità nel tempo

- Passione ed entusiasmo per lo sviluppo personale

- Conoscenza orale e scritta

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

Z informazioni aggiuntive

A seconda delle esigenze individuali di lavoro e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente sia il lavoro flessibile che quello part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci (elif.yabas@zurich.com) per discutere le potenziali possibilità.

- Luogo di lavoro: Colonia

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: a tempo pieno

Elif Yabas non vede l'ora di presentare i tuoi documenti di applicazione con le tue aspettative di stipendio e la possibile data di inizio tramite il portale di carriera (“Applica ora” pulsante). Purtroppo non possiamo considerare le applicazioni via e-mail.

Benvenuti nel vostro futuro

55.000 colleghi in 2515 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

The Zurich Group Audit is a diverse international team of more than 275 colleagues from 33 different nations, working worldwide as a function with a common goal: to keep Zurich safe. Together, we bring our skills, competencies and unique strengths to give our stakeholders valuable insight and drive positive change. Our mission is to be the best for our company, our employees and our community. We are committed to continuous learning and improvement and strive to be excellent at what we do and how we do it. To support this, we are transforming into a fully digital, data-driven and AI-powered feature that maximizes our human capabilities through technological innovation.

As a senior auditor: with a finance and investment focus, you work with members of the audit team in all aspects of an audit – from planning, determining the scope, evaluating material risks, conception and operational assessment to reporting. You will work with Group Audit team members and develop a deep understanding of the business and its risks. Together, you develop high-quality auditing approaches, including the use of data analytics, the evaluation of IT fundamentals and the use of GenAI. In addition, you support the creation of reports that provide important insights and influence stakeholders in Germany.

You foster a collaborative, learning-oriented team environment and contribute to strategic priorities. You will learn and apply innovative exam approaches as well as “New World Skills” (data analytics, IT). The following interesting tasks await you with us:

- Value-creating audits: You support the timely execution of effective audits in exceptional quality. You use data analytics and GenAI to evaluate IT fundamentals throughout the audit process.

- Significant reporting: You contribute to the creation of concise and effective findings.

- Building strong relationships: You build and maintain constructive relationships with stakeholders during audits.

- Promote learning culture: You take an active role in the further development of your professional, digital and social skills and apply a growth and learning mentality.

- Use new competencies: You will actively develop your “New World Skills”: Data, IT and GenAI and recognize their importance for optimal examination results and the future protection of your skills.

- Collaboration as a unit: You work together at all levels during the audits to achieve the best possible results.

- Maintain ethics and integrity: You set the highest standards of ethics and integrity and ensure compliance with all relevant standards, regulations and internal policies.

You bring that with you

Personally, you inspire us with your strong team skills and the ability to work independently if necessary!

Convince us with your meaningful application if the following qualifications also distinguish you:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional qualification (e.g. CPA, CIA, CISA, MBA or equivalent)

- Many years of professional experience in audit, risk management or compliance

- Experience in complex, dynamic and international organizations

- Good knowledge of audit methodology, internal audit standards and internal control framework desirable

- Good knowledge of finance, investments and life insurance

- Experience and good understanding of “New World Skills” (DA, ITGC and GenAI)

- Good project management skills, ability to effectively prioritize and deliver high-quality results on time

- Passion and enthusiasm for personal development

- Fluent oral and written English skills

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent work environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Z additional information

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us (elif.yabas@zurich.com ) to discuss the potential possibilities.

- Place of work: Cologne

- Part-time or full-time: full-time

Elif Yabas is looking forward to your application documents with your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Welcome to your future

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

À Zurich, nous revivons l'assurance. Afin de satisfaire encore mieux les souhaits de nos clients, nous allons de nouvelles façons, pensons créativement, travail agile. Notre culture d'entreprise vous donne plus de flexibilité à tous égards – et beaucoup de liberté pour se développer de manière optimale. Pensez grand – et aussi international! Parce que vos possibilités de développement ne connaissent aucune limite avec nous. Prêt à prendre le futur en main ?

C'est ce qui vous attend

Le Groupe Audit de Zurich est une équipe internationale diversifiée de plus de 275 collègues de 33 pays différents, travaillant dans le monde entier dans un but commun : garder Zurich en sécurité. Ensemble, nous apportons nos compétences, nos compétences et nos forces uniques afin de donner à nos intervenants un précieux aperçu et de susciter des changements positifs. Notre mission est d'être le meilleur pour notre entreprise, nos employés et notre communauté. Nous sommes attachés à l'apprentissage et à l'amélioration continus et nous nous efforçons d'être excellents dans ce que nous faisons et comment nous le faisons. À cette fin, nous nous transformons en une fonction entièrement numérique, axée sur les données et alimentée par l'IA qui maximise nos capacités humaines grâce à l'innovation technologique.

En tant que vérificateur principal : avec un accent sur les finances et les investissements, vous travaillez avec les membres de l'équipe de vérification dans tous les aspects d'une vérification – de la planification, de la détermination de la portée, de l'évaluation des risques matériels, de la conception et de l'évaluation opérationnelle à la présentation de rapports. Vous travaillerez avec les membres de l'équipe de vérification de groupe et développerez une compréhension approfondie de l'entreprise et de ses risques. Ensemble, vous développez des méthodes d'audit de haute qualité, y compris l'utilisation de l'analyse des données, l'évaluation des fondamentaux informatiques et l'utilisation de GenAI. En outre, vous soutenez la création de rapports qui fournissent des informations importantes et influencent les parties prenantes en Allemagne.

Vous favorisez un environnement d'équipe collaboratif et axé sur l'apprentissage et contribuez aux priorités stratégiques. Vous apprendrez et appliquerez des approches d'examen innovantes ainsi que -New World Skills (analyse de données, IT). Les tâches intéressantes suivantes vous attendent avec nous:

- Audits générateurs de valeur : Vous soutenez l'exécution en temps opportun d'audits efficaces de qualité exceptionnelle. Vous utilisez l'analyse de données et GenAI pour évaluer les fondamentaux informatiques tout au long du processus d'audit.

- Rapports importants : Vous contribuez à la création de constatations concises et efficaces.

- Établir des relations solides : Vous établissez et maintenez des relations constructives avec les intervenants au cours des vérifications.

- Promouvoir la culture d'apprentissage : Vous participez activement au développement de vos compétences professionnelles, numériques et sociales et appliquez une mentalité de croissance et d'apprentissage.

- Utilisez de nouvelles compétences: Vous développerez activement vos compétences du nouveau monde: Data, IT et GenAI reconnaissent leur importance pour des résultats d'examen optimaux et la protection future de vos compétences.

- Collaboration en tant qu'unité : Vous travaillez ensemble à tous les niveaux pendant les audits pour obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles.

- Maintenir l'éthique et l'intégrité : Vous fixez les normes les plus élevées en matière d'éthique et d'intégrité et veillez à la conformité à toutes les normes, règlements et politiques internes pertinents.

Apporte ça avec toi.

Personnellement, vous nous inspirez avec vos solides compétences en équipe et la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante si nécessaire!

Convainquez-nous avec votre application significative si les qualifications suivantes vous distinguent également:

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent ou une qualification professionnelle équivalente (par exemple CPA, CIA, CISA, MBA ou équivalent)

- De nombreuses années d'expérience professionnelle en vérification, gestion des risques ou conformité

- Expérience des organisations complexes, dynamiques et internationales

jobs.description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there future intern!

I am Alba Marin the recruiter for this position (and hopefully, your future colleague!).

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich !

Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading!

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What can you expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked – I asked myself the same question at the time.

As a Digital Associate Intern you will have the opportunity to:

- Collaborate on exciting projects, such as improving the digital adoption of our agents by bringing fresh ideas to the table and contributing to ongoing transformation initiatives.

- Develop and deploy innovative tech solutions, such as AI-powered tools that enhance user efficiency and streamline internal processes, supporting our teams in delivering better and faster results.

- Work alongside experts in various technological domains.

- Enhance your skills with real-world experience

- Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

- Active student status with a Spanish University/School is mandatory.

- Passionate about a tech career.

- Available for at least a 6-month part-time/internship program.

- Tech-savvy with a curious mind.

- Enthusiastic, capable, and eager to learn.

- A good team player with a responsible, can-do attitude.

- Hands on person with interest to Configure and customize digital tools to meet business requirements.

- Knowledge of front-end development is a plus.

- Able to understand Business requirements and translate into technical requirements.

- Interest in digital project management, with basic knowledge of project management tools and familiarity with digital technologies such as APIs, data platforms, or AI-based tools.

And… What Makes Us Special?

- Paid Internship, up to 30 hours weekly with a flexible schedule.

- LinkedIn and internal training opportunities.

- Special discounts on various brands and products, plus great banking and insurance conditions.

- A welcome pack filled with amazing gadgets.

- A dynamic workspace with tasty coffee and fruit and featuring gaming, gym, and other fun areas!

- Summer and Christmas events and different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more

Looking for a place to start or further develop your career? This is for you! Zurich offers a comprehensive career plan providing a great opportunity to build and enhance your career from the start. You will have the chance to work on global projects, guided by experts and leveraging innovative technologies. Learn from very well-known experts in the field, ensuring you gain valuable experience and knowledge.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

#Li-hybrid

It’s a match? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English .

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share this amazing opportunity with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): ES - Barcelona

- Schedule: Part Time

- Recruiter name: Alba Marin Sola
